features.name: Ancestral Protectors
features.desc: While raging, the first creature you hit on your turn has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the start of your next turn, and anyone else it hits has resistance to that attack's damage. Ends early if your rage ends.

features.name: Spirit Shield
features.desc: While raging, when a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, use your reaction to reduce it by 2d6 (3d6 at 10th level, 4d6 at 14th).

features.name: Consult the Spirits
features.desc: Cast augury or clairvoyance without a slot or material components (Wisdom); clairvoyance summons an invisible ancestral spirit instead of a sensor. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Vengeful Ancestors
features.desc: When Spirit Shield reduces an attack's damage, the attacker takes force damage equal to the amount prevented.

features.name: Storm Aura
features.desc: While raging, a 10-foot aura activates on entering rage and again as a bonus action each turn; save DC 8 + proficiency + Con. Choose an environment (change on leveling): Desert, other creatures in the aura take 2 fire (3 at 5th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th); Sea, one creature makes a Dex save, 1d6 lightning, half on success (2d6 at 10th, 3d6 at 15th, 4d6 at 20th); Tundra, chosen creatures gain 2 temporary HP (3 at 5th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th).

features.name: Storm Soul
features.desc: Desert: fire resistance, ignore extreme heat, set an unattended flammable object alight with an action. Sea: lightning resistance, breathe underwater, swim speed 30 feet. Tundra: cold resistance, ignore extreme cold, freeze a 5-foot cube of water for 1 minute with an action.

features.name: Shielding Storm
features.desc: Creatures of your choice in your aura share your Storm Soul resistance.

features.name: Raging Storm
features.desc: Desert: after a creature in your aura hits you, reaction for a Dex save or fire damage equal to half your barbarian level. Sea: after you hit a creature in your aura, reaction for a Str save or it falls prone. Tundra: each time the aura activates, one creature in it makes a Str save or its speed is 0 until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.desc: While raging, the first creature you hit with a weapon each turn takes an extra 1d6 + half your barbarian level, necrotic or radiant (chosen when you gain this).

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.desc: Spells that only restore you to life (not undeath) need no material components.

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.desc: Once per rage, reroll a failed saving throw and use the new roll.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.desc: Bonus action: up to ten other creatures of your choice within 60 feet that can hear you have advantage on attacks and saves until the start of your next turn. Once per long rest.

features.name: Rage beyond Death
features.desc: While raging, 0 hit points doesn't knock you unconscious; you still make death saves, but you don't die until your rage ends, and then only if still at 0 HP.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.desc: Bonus action, spend a Bardic Inspiration: up to Cha mod (min 1) creatures within 60 feet that can see you gain 5 temporary HP (8 at 5th, 11 at 10th, 14 at 15th) and can use a reaction to move their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Enthralling Performance
features.desc: After performing for 1 minute, up to Cha mod (min 1) humanoids within 60 feet that watched make a Wis save or are charmed for 1 hour, idolizing you; ends if damaged or if you attack them or their allies. Failed targets don't know. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.desc: Bonus action: cast command without a slot, then again as a bonus action each turn for 1 minute (concentration). Creatures charmed by you automatically fail. Once per long rest.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.desc: Bonus action, 1 minute or until incapacitated: a creature attacking you for the first time on a turn makes a Cha save or must pick another target (or waste the attack); on a success it has disadvantage on saves against your spells on your next turn. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Medium armor and the scimitar; a proficient simple or martial melee weapon can be your bard spellcasting focus.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.desc: Choose Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting.

features.name: Blade Flourish
features.desc: When you take the Attack action, +10 feet walking speed this turn; once per turn on a weapon hit, spend a Bardic Inspiration die for extra damage equal to the roll plus one flourish: Defensive (add the roll to AC until your next turn), Slashing (same damage to another creature within 5 feet), or Mobile (push 5 feet plus the roll, then reaction to move your speed to a space within 5 feet of the target).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Master's Flourish
features.desc: Roll a d6 for a Blade Flourish instead of spending Bardic Inspiration.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.desc: Once per round on your turn, on a weapon hit, spend a Bardic Inspiration for an extra 2d6 psychic (3d6 at 5th, 5d6 at 10th, 8d6 at 15th).

features.name: Words of Terror
features.desc: After talking 1 minute alone with a humanoid, it makes a Wis save or is frightened of you or another creature you choose for 1 hour or until it or an ally is attacked or damaged. Failed targets don't know. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Mantle of Whispers
features.desc: Reaction when a humanoid dies within 30 feet: capture its shadow until a long rest. As an action, become a disguise of that person for 1 hour, with what it would share with a casual acquaintance; Insight vs your Deception +5 sees through it. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Shadow Lore
features.desc: Action, one creature within 30 feet that can hear and understand you makes a Wis save or is charmed for 8 hours (ends if you or allies harm it or force a save), believing you know its deepest secret; it obeys you short of risking its life. Once per long rest.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: identify, searing smite (1st); heat metal, magic weapon (3rd); elemental weapon, protection from energy (5th); fabricate, wall of fire (7th); animate objects, creation (9th).

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Heavy armor and smith's tools.

features.name: Blessing of the Forge
features.desc: At the end of a long rest, touch a nonmagical suit of armor or simple or martial weapon: it becomes magic (+1 AC, or +1 to attack and damage) until your next long rest or your death.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
features.desc: A 1-hour ritual crafts a nonmagical metal-containing item worth up to 100 gp (weapon, armor, ten ammunition, tools, other metal object), consuming metal or coins of equal value; can duplicate a metal item you hold, such as a key.

features.name: Soul of the Forge
features.desc: Resistance to fire damage; +1 AC while wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.desc: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 fire (2d8 at 14th level).

features.name: Saint of Forge and Fire
features.desc: Immunity to fire damage; while wearing heavy armor, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: bane, false life (1st); gentle repose, ray of enfeeblement (3rd); revivify, vampiric touch (5th); blight, death ward (7th); antilife shell, raise dead (9th).

features.name: Circle of Mortality
features.desc: Healing dice from your spells use their maximum on a creature at 0 hit points. You learn spare the dying (not counted against your cantrips), with 30-foot range and castable as a bonus action.

features.name: Eyes of the Grave
features.desc: Action: until the end of your next turn you know the location of undead within 60 feet not behind total cover or shielded from divination. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
features.desc: Action, curse one creature within 30 feet until the end of your next turn: the next attack by you or an ally that hits it deals vulnerable damage, then the curse ends.

features.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
features.desc: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet suffers a critical hit: make it a normal hit, cancelling crit-triggered effects. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.desc: Add your Wisdom modifier to cleric cantrip damage.

features.name: Keeper of Souls
features.desc: When an enemy you can see dies within 60 feet, you or a creature within 60 feet regains HP equal to its Hit Dice count, if you aren't incapacitated. Once per turn cycle (until the start of your next turn).

features.name: Balm of the Summer Court
features.desc: A pool of d6s equal to your druid level, refilled on a long rest. Bonus action: spend up to half your druid level in dice on a creature within 120 feet; it regains the total in HP plus 1 temporary HP per die.

features.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
features.desc: At the start of a rest, an invisible 30-foot-radius sphere: you and allies inside have +5 to Stealth and Perception, and firelight inside isn't visible outside. Ends with the rest or if you leave.

features.name: Hidden Paths
features.desc: Bonus action: teleport up to 60 feet; or action: teleport a willing creature you touch up to 30 feet. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Walker in Dreams
features.desc: After a short rest, cast dream (you as messenger), scrying, or teleportation circle without a slot or material components; the circle opens to where you last finished a long rest on this plane. Once per long rest.

features.name: Speech of the Woods
features.desc: You speak, read and write Sylvan; beasts understand you and you can read their noises and motions.

features.name: Spirit Totem
features.desc: Bonus action: summon a spirit at a point within 60 feet with a 30-foot aura for 1 minute (bonus action moves it 60 feet). Once per short or long rest. Bear: chosen creatures gain 5 + druid level temporary HP, and you and allies have advantage on Str checks and saves in the aura. Hawk: reaction to give advantage on an attack against a target in the aura; you and allies have advantage on Perception there. Unicorn: advantage on checks to detect creatures in the aura, and when your slotted spell heals anyone, chosen creatures in the aura also regain HP equal to your druid level.

features.name: Mighty Summoner
features.desc: Beasts and fey your spells summon or create get 2 extra HP per Hit Die, and their natural weapons count as magical.

features.name: Guardian Spirit
features.desc: A beast or fey you summoned that ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura regains HP equal to half your druid level.

features.name: Faithful Summons
features.desc: When reduced to 0 HP or incapacitated against your will, gain conjure animals as a 9th-level casting: four beasts of CR 2 or lower within 20 feet protect you for 1 hour, no concentration. Once per long rest.

features.name: Arcane Archer Lore
features.desc: Proficiency in Arcana or Nature, and the prestidigitation or druidcraft cantrip.

features.name: Arcane Shot
features.desc: Learn two Arcane Shot options (one more at 7th, 10th, 15th and 18th). Once per turn, when you fire a shortbow or longbow arrow as part of the Attack action, apply an option (decided on hit unless it has no attack roll). Two uses per short or long rest. Save DC 8 + proficiency + Int. Options, extra damage doubling at 18th: Banishing (Cha save or banished to the Feywild until the end of its next turn; +2d6 force at 18th), Beguiling (+2d6 psychic, Wis save or charmed by an ally within 30 feet until your next turn), Bursting (2d6 force to the target and everything within 10 feet), Enfeebling (+2d6 necrotic, Con save or its weapon damage is halved until your next turn), Grasping (+2d6 poison, speed -10 feet and 2d6 slashing whenever it moves, for 1 minute or until removed with Athletics vs your DC), Piercing (no attack roll: 1-by-30-foot line through cover, Dex save for arrow damage +1d6 piercing, half on success), Seeking (no attack roll: hits a creature seen in the last minute around corners, Dex save for arrow damage +1d6 force and you learn its location, half on success), Shadow (+2d6 psychic, Wis save or it can't see beyond 5 feet until your next turn).

features.name: Magic Arrow
features.desc: Nonmagical arrows you fire from a shortbow or longbow count as magical.

features.name: Curving Shot
features.desc: When you miss with a magic arrow, bonus action to reroll against a different target within 60 feet of the first.

features.name: Ever-Ready Shot
features.desc: If you roll initiative with no Arcane Shot uses left, regain one.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.desc: One of Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or one language.

features.name: Born to the Saddle
features.desc: Advantage on saves to avoid falling off your mount; land on your feet from a fall of 10 feet or less if not incapacitated; mounting or dismounting costs 5 feet of movement.

features.name: Unwavering Mark
features.desc: When you hit with a melee weapon, mark the creature until the end of your next turn: within 5 feet of you it has disadvantage attacking anyone but you. If it damages someone else, on your next turn a bonus-action melee attack against it has advantage and deals extra damage equal to half your fighter level. Str mod special attacks (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Warding Maneuver
features.desc: Reaction when you or a creature within 5 feet is hit, while wielding a melee weapon or shield: add 1d8 to the target's AC against it; if it still hits, the target has resistance to that damage. Con mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Hold the Line
features.desc: Creatures provoke your opportunity attack when they move 5 feet or more within your reach, and a hit reduces their speed to 0 for the turn.

features.name: Ferocious Charger
features.desc: Once per turn, after moving 10 feet straight before a hit, the target makes a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency + Str) or falls prone.

features.name: Vigilant Defender
features.desc: A special reaction usable once on every other creature's turn, only for an opportunity attack, and not on a turn you use your normal reaction.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.desc: One of History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or one language.

features.name: Fighting Spirit
features.desc: Bonus action: advantage on weapon attacks this turn and 5 temporary HP (10 at 10th level, 15 at 15th). Three uses per long rest.

features.name: Elegant Courtier
features.desc: Add your Wisdom modifier to Persuasion checks; proficiency in Wisdom saves (or Intelligence or Charisma if you already have it).

features.name: Tireless Spirit
features.desc: If you roll initiative with no Fighting Spirit uses left, regain one.

features.name: Rapid Strike
features.desc: Once per turn during the Attack action, give up advantage on one attack to make an extra weapon attack against that target.

features.name: Strength before Death
features.desc: When damage drops you to 0 HP without killing you, reaction: take an extra turn immediately, interrupting the current one; damage at 0 HP still causes death save failures. Fall unconscious after it if still at 0. Once per long rest.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Performance and brewer's supplies.

features.name: Drunken Technique
features.desc: Flurry of Blows also grants the Disengage action and +10 feet walking speed this turn.

features.name: Tipsy Sway
features.desc: Stand up from prone for 5 feet of movement. When a creature misses you with a melee attack, spend 1 ki as a reaction to have it hit another creature of your choice within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Drunkard's Luck
features.desc: Spend 2 ki to cancel disadvantage on an ability check, attack roll or saving throw.

features.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
features.desc: Flurry of Blows can make up to three more attacks (five total) if each one targets a different creature this turn.

features.name: Path of the Kensei
features.desc: Choose one melee and one ranged kensei weapon (simple or martial without heavy or special; longbow allowed), gaining proficiency; they count as monk weapons. One more at 6th, 11th and 17th. Agile Parry: after an unarmed strike in the Attack action while holding a melee kensei weapon, +2 AC until your next turn. Kensei's Shot: bonus action, ranged kensei hits deal +1d4 this turn. Way of the Brush: calligrapher's or painter's supplies.

features.name: One with the Blade
features.desc: Kensei weapon attacks count as magical. Deft Strike: once per turn on a kensei weapon hit, spend 1 ki for extra damage equal to your Martial Arts die.

features.name: Sharpen the Blade
features.desc: Bonus action: spend up to 3 ki to give a kensei weapon you touch that bonus to attack and damage for 1 minute (not on a weapon that already has a bonus).

features.name: Unerring Accuracy
features.desc: Once per turn, reroll a missed monk weapon attack.

features.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
features.desc: A ranged spell attack option in the Attack action: 30 feet, Dex to attack and damage, radiant, Martial Arts die. After using it in the Attack action, spend 1 ki to make it twice as a bonus action. With Extra Attack, any of your attacks can be this.

features.name: Searing Arc Strike
features.desc: Right after the Attack action, spend 2 ki to cast burning hands as a bonus action, +1 spell level per extra ki (max ki half your monk level).

features.name: Searing Sunburst
features.desc: Action: a 20-foot-radius sphere at a point within 150 feet; Con save or 2d6 radiant (opaque total cover protects). Spend up to 3 ki for +2d6 each.

features.name: Sun Shield
features.desc: Bright light 30 feet and dim 30 more (toggle as a bonus action). While lit, reaction when hit by a melee attack: deal 5 + Wis mod radiant to the attacker.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: armor of Agathys, command (3rd); hold person, spiritual weapon (5th); bestow curse, fear (9th); dominate beast, stoneskin (13th); cloudkill, dominate person (17th).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: Conquering Presence: action, chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Wis save or are frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn. Guided Strike: +10 to an attack roll after seeing the roll.

features.name: Aura of Conquest
features.desc: A 10-foot aura (30 feet at 18th) while not incapacitated: creatures frightened of you have speed 0 in it and take psychic damage equal to half your paladin level when they start their turn there.

features.name: Scornful Rebuke
features.desc: A creature that hits you takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (min 1), if you aren't incapacitated.

features.name: Invincible Conqueror
features.desc: Action, 1 minute: resistance to all damage, one extra attack in the Attack action, and melee weapon crits on 19 or 20. Once per long rest.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: sanctuary, sleep (3rd); calm emotions, hold person (5th); counterspell, hypnotic pattern (9th); Otiluke's resilient sphere, stoneskin (13th); hold monster, wall of force (17th).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: Emissary of Peace: bonus action, +5 to Persuasion for 10 minutes. Rebuke the Violent: reaction right after an attacker within 30 feet damages someone other than you; it makes a Wis save, taking radiant damage equal to what it dealt, half on a success.

features.name: Aura of the Guardian
features.desc: Reaction when a creature within 10 feet (30 at 18th) takes damage: you take that damage instead; it can't be reduced and no other effects transfer.

features.name: Protective Spirit
features.desc: If you end your turn in combat below half your hit points and aren't incapacitated, regain 1d6 + half your paladin level HP.

features.name: Emissary of Redemption
features.desc: Resistance to all damage dealt by other creatures, and a creature that hits you takes radiant damage equal to half the damage you took. Both stop working against a creature you attack, cast a spell on, or damage, until you finish a long rest.

features.name: Gloom Stalker Magic
features.desc: Known extra spells: disguise self (3rd), rope trick (5th), fear (9th), greater invisibility (13th), seeming (17th).

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.desc: Add Wis mod to initiative. On your first turn of each combat, +10 feet walking speed, and the Attack action includes one extra weapon attack that deals +1d8 on a hit.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.desc: Darkvision 60 feet (or +30 feet if you have it). In darkness you are invisible to creatures relying on darkvision to see you.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.desc: Proficiency in Wisdom saves (or Intelligence or Charisma if you already have it).

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.desc: Once per turn, when you miss with a weapon attack, make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.desc: Reaction, before the result is known, when attacked without advantage: impose disadvantage.

features.name: Horizon Walker Magic
features.desc: Known extra spells: protection from evil and good (3rd), misty step (5th), haste (9th), banishment (13th), teleportation circle (17th).

features.name: Detect Portal
features.desc: Action: learn the distance and direction to the nearest planar portal within 1 mile. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Planar Warrior
features.desc: Bonus action, choose a creature within 30 feet: your next weapon hit on it this turn deals all force damage plus 1d8 force (2d8 at 11th).

features.name: Ethereal Step
features.desc: Bonus action: cast etherealness without a slot, ending at the end of the turn. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Distant Strike
features.desc: During the Attack action, teleport up to 10 feet before each attack; if you attack two different creatures, make one extra attack against a third.

features.name: Spectral Defense
features.desc: Reaction when an attack damages you: resistance to all of that attack's damage this turn.

features.name: Monster Slayer Magic
features.desc: Known extra spells: protection from evil and good (3rd), zone of truth (5th), magic circle (9th), banishment (13th), hold monster (17th).

features.name: Hunter's Sense
features.desc: Action, a creature within 60 feet: learn its damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities (none, if it is shielded from divination). Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Slayer's Prey
features.desc: Bonus action, mark a creature within 60 feet until a short or long rest or a new mark: the first weapon hit on it each turn deals +1d6.

features.name: Supernatural Defense
features.desc: Add 1d6 to saves your Slayer's Prey target forces and to checks to escape its grapple.

features.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
features.desc: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell or teleports: Wis save against your spell DC or it fails and is wasted. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Slayer's Counter
features.desc: When your Slayer's Prey target forces a save, reaction: one weapon attack against it first; on a hit you automatically succeed on the save.

features.name: Ear for Deceit
features.desc: On Insight checks to tell if a creature lies, treat a d20 of 7 or lower as 8.

features.name: Eye for Detail
features.desc: Bonus action: a Perception check to spot a hidden creature or object, or an Investigation check for clues.

features.name: Insightful Fighting
features.desc: Bonus action: your Insight vs a visible creature's Deception; on a win you can Sneak Attack it without advantage (not with disadvantage) for 1 minute or until you use this on another target.

features.name: Steady Eye
features.desc: Advantage on Perception and Investigation if you move no more than half your speed this turn.

features.name: Unerring Eye
features.desc: Action: sense illusions, shapechangers in another form, and other deceiving magic within 30 feet, unless blinded or deafened (not what is hidden). Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Eye for Weakness
features.desc: Sneak Attack deals +3d6 against your Insightful Fighting target.

features.name: Master of Intrigue
features.desc: Disguise kit, forgery kit, one gaming set and two languages; after 1 minute of listening you can mimic a creature's speech and accent in a language you know.

features.name: Master of Tactics
features.desc: Help as a bonus action; when you help an ally attack, the target can be within 30 feet of you if it can see or hear you.

features.name: Insightful Manipulator
features.desc: After 1 minute observing or talking to a creature outside combat, learn whether it is your equal, superior or inferior in two of: Int, Wis, Cha, class levels.

features.name: Misdirection
features.desc: Reaction when targeted by an attack while a creature within 5 feet gives you cover: the attack targets that creature instead.

features.name: Soul of Deceit
features.desc: Your thoughts can't be read unless you allow it, and you can present false thoughts (Deception vs Insight). Truth-detecting magic shows you as truthful if you wish, and magic can't compel you to tell the truth.

features.name: Skirmisher
features.desc: Reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet: move up to half your speed without provoking.

features.name: Survivalist
features.desc: Proficiency in Nature and Survival, with double proficiency bonus on checks using them.

features.name: Superior Mobility
features.desc: +10 feet walking speed, and climbing and swimming speeds if you have them.

features.name: Ambush Master
features.desc: Advantage on initiative; attacks against the first creature you hit in the first round have advantage until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Sudden Strike
features.desc: When you take the Attack action, one extra attack as a bonus action; it can Sneak Attack even if you already did this turn, but not the same target twice.

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.desc: A creature you make a melee attack against can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.desc: Add Cha mod to initiative. Sneak Attack without advantage when you're within 5 feet of the target, no other creature is within 5 feet of you, and you don't have disadvantage.

features.name: Panache
features.desc: Action: Persuasion vs Insight against a creature that hears and understands you. Hostile: for 1 minute it has disadvantage attacking anyone but you and can only make opportunity attacks against you (ends if an ally attacks or spells it, or you're 60+ feet apart). Not hostile: charmed for 1 minute as a friendly acquaintance, ending if harmed.

features.name: Elegant Maneuver
features.desc: Bonus action: advantage on your next Acrobatics or Athletics check this turn.

features.name: Master Duelist
features.desc: Reroll a missed attack with advantage. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Divine Magic
features.desc: When you learn or replace a sorcerer spell or cantrip, you can pick from the cleric list; it becomes a sorcerer spell. Pick an affinity for a bonus spell that doesn't count against spells known: good cure wounds, evil inflict wounds, law bless, chaos bane, neutrality protection from evil and good.

features.name: Favored by the Gods
features.desc: When you fail a save or miss an attack, add 2d4 to the total. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Empowered Healing
features.desc: Once per turn, when you or an ally within 5 feet rolls healing dice for a spell, spend 1 sorcery point to reroll any of them once, if you aren't incapacitated.

features.name: Otherworldly Wings
features.desc: Bonus action: spectral wings give a 30-foot flying speed until you're incapacitated, die or dismiss them.

features.name: Unearthly Recovery
features.desc: Bonus action below half your hit points: regain half your hit point maximum. Once per long rest.

features.name: Eyes of the Dark
features.desc: Darkvision 120 feet. At 3rd level you learn darkness (not counted against spells known) and can cast it for 2 sorcery points, seeing through it when you do.

features.name: Strength of the Grave
features.desc: When damage drops you to 0 HP, Cha save (DC 5 + damage taken) to drop to 1 HP instead; not against radiant damage or a critical hit. Once per long rest after a success.

features.name: Hound of Ill Omen
features.desc: Bonus action, 3 sorcery points: summon a Medium monstrosity dire wolf within 30 feet of a target you can see within 120 feet, with temporary HP equal to half your sorcerer level. It moves through creatures and objects (5 force if it ends in one), always knows the target's location, moves and attacks only that target, and while within 5 feet the target has disadvantage on saves against your spells. Lasts 5 minutes or until it or the target drops to 0.

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.desc: In dim light or darkness, bonus action: teleport up to 120 feet to a space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.desc: Bonus action, 6 sorcery points, 1 minute: resistance to all damage except force and radiant, and move through creatures and objects (5 force if you end a turn inside one).

features.name: Wind Speaker
features.desc: Speak, read and write Primordial (understanding Aquan, Auran, Ignan and Terran).

features.name: Tempestuous Magic
features.desc: Bonus action right before or after casting a spell of 1st level or higher: fly up to 10 feet without provoking.

features.name: Heart of the Storm
features.desc: Resistance to lightning and thunder. When you start casting a 1st-level-plus spell that deals lightning or thunder, chosen creatures within 10 feet take lightning or thunder damage equal to half your sorcerer level.

features.name: Storm Guide
features.desc: Action: stop rain in a 20-foot sphere around you. Bonus action each round: set the wind's direction in a 100-foot sphere until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Storm's Fury
features.desc: Reaction when hit by a melee attack: lightning damage equal to your sorcerer level to the attacker, and a Str save against your spell DC or it is pushed up to 20 feet.

features.name: Wind Soul
features.desc: Immunity to lightning and thunder; magical flying speed 60 feet. Action: drop to 30 feet for 1 hour to give 3 + Cha mod creatures within 30 feet a 30-foot flying speed for 1 hour. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.desc: Added to your warlock list: cure wounds, guiding bolt (1st); flaming sphere, lesser restoration (2nd); daylight, revivify (3rd); guardian of faith, wall of fire (4th); flame strike, greater restoration (5th).

features.name: Bonus Cantrips
features.desc: Light and sacred flame, not counted against cantrips known.

features.name: Healing Light
features.desc: A pool of 1 + warlock level d6s, refilled on a long rest. Bonus action: heal a creature within 60 feet, spending up to Cha mod dice (min 1).

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.desc: Resistance to radiant; add Cha mod to one radiant or fire damage roll of your spells against one target.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.desc: After a short or long rest, gain temporary HP equal to warlock level + Cha mod, and up to five creatures you can see gain half your warlock level + Cha mod.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.desc: Instead of a death save at the start of your turn, regain half your hit point maximum and stand if you like; chosen creatures within 30 feet take 2d8 + Cha mod radiant and are blinded until the end of the turn. Once per long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.desc: Added to your warlock list: shield, wrathful smite (1st); blur, branding smite (2nd); blink, elemental weapon (3rd); phantasmal killer, staggering smite (4th); banishing smite, cone of cold (5th).

features.name: Hexblade's Curse
features.desc: Bonus action, curse a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute: add proficiency bonus to damage against it, your attacks against it crit on 19 or 20, and if it dies you regain warlock level + Cha mod HP (min 1). Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Hex Warrior
features.desc: Medium armor, shields and martial weapons. After a long rest, touch a proficient weapon without two-handed: use Cha for its attack and damage until the next long rest; with Pact of the Blade this applies to every pact weapon.

features.name: Accursed Specter
features.desc: When you slay a humanoid, its spirit rises as a specter with temporary HP equal to half your warlock level and a bonus to attacks equal to your Cha mod; it obeys you until your next long rest. Once per long rest.

features.name: Armor of Hexes
features.desc: Reaction when your cursed target hits you: roll a d6, and on 4 or higher the attack misses.

features.name: Master of Hexes
features.desc: When your cursed target dies, move the curse to another creature within 30 feet (without regaining HP from the death).

features.name: Arcane Deflection
features.desc: Reaction when hit or when you fail a save: +2 AC against that attack or +4 to that save; then only cantrips until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Tactical Wit
features.desc: Add Int mod to initiative.

features.name: Power Surge
features.desc: Hold up to Int mod (min 1) power surges; reset to one on a long rest, gain one when you end a spell with dispel magic or counterspell, and one after a short rest if you have none. Once per turn when a wizard spell damages a target, spend one for extra force damage equal to half your wizard level.

features.name: Durable Magic
features.desc: +2 to AC and all saves while concentrating on a spell.

features.name: Deflecting Shroud
features.desc: When you use Arcane Deflection, up to three creatures within 60 feet take force damage equal to half your wizard level.

features.name: Form of the Beast
features.desc: When you rage, manifest a natural weapon (simple melee, Str) chosen each rage: Bite 1d8 piercing, once per turn regain HP equal to proficiency bonus if below half HP; Claws 1d6 slashing, one extra claw attack when you attack with a claw in the Attack action; Tail 1d8 piercing with reach, and reaction when a creature within 10 feet hits you to add 1d8 to AC.

features.name: Bestial Soul
features.desc: Natural weapons count as magical. After a short or long rest pick one until the next: swim speed and water breathing; climb speed with spider climbing; or once per turn add a Str (Athletics) check total to a jump's distance.

features.name: Infectious Fury
features.desc: While raging, on a natural weapon hit the target makes a Wis save (DC 8 + Con + proficiency) or, your choice, uses its reaction to make a melee attack against a creature you choose, or takes 2d12 psychic. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Call the Hunt
features.desc: When you rage, up to Con mod (min 1) willing creatures within 30 feet join: you gain 5 temporary HP per creature, and each can add 1d6 to one attack's damage per turn until the rage ends. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Magic Awareness
features.desc: Action: until the end of your next turn, know the location and school of spells and magic items within 60 feet not behind total cover. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Wild Surge
features.desc: When you rage, roll a d8 (save DC 8 + proficiency + Con): 1 chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Con save or take 1d12 necrotic, and you gain 1d12 temporary HP; 2 teleport 30 feet, repeatable as a bonus action each turn; 3 an exploding spirit next to a creature within 30 feet, Dex save or 1d6 force, repeatable as a bonus action; 4 a held weapon deals force, gains light and thrown (20/60) and returns to your hand; 5 attackers who hit you take 1d6 force; 6 +1 AC for you and allies within 10 feet; 7 the ground within 15 feet is difficult terrain for enemies; 8 a creature within 30 feet makes a Con save or takes 1d6 radiant and is blinded until your next turn, repeatable as a bonus action. Each lasts until the rage ends.

features.name: Bolstering Magic
features.desc: Action, touch a creature (or yourself): either add 1d3 to attack rolls and ability checks for 10 minutes, or it regains a spell slot of level 1d3 or lower (once per long rest per creature). Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Unstable Backlash
features.desc: While raging, reaction right after you take damage or fail a save: roll a new Wild Surge, replacing the current one.

features.name: Controlled Surge
features.desc: Roll Wild Surge twice and choose; on a matching roll pick any effect.

features.name: Mote of Potential
features.desc: When you give Bardic Inspiration, a mote orbits the creature until the die is used. Ability check: roll the die twice and pick. Attack roll: the target and chosen creatures within 5 feet of it make a Con save against your spell DC or take thunder damage equal to the roll. Saving throw: the creature gains temporary HP equal to the roll + your Cha mod (min 1).

features.name: Performance of Creation
features.desc: Action: create one nonmagical Medium or smaller item worth up to 20 x bard level gp within 10 feet, lasting proficiency bonus hours (one at a time; Large at 6th, Huge at 14th). Once per long rest, or spend a 2nd-level or higher slot.

features.name: Animating Performance
features.desc: Action: animate a Large or smaller unattended nonmagical item within 30 feet as a Dancing Item for 1 hour (AC 16, HP 10 + 5 x bard level, speed 30, fly 30 hover; slam with your spell attack, 1d10 + PB force; nearby creatures' speed can change by 10 feet). It acts after you and Dodges unless commanded with a bonus action (or with your Bardic Inspiration bonus action). Once per long rest, or spend a 3rd-level or higher slot.

features.name: Creative Crescendo
features.desc: Performance of Creation makes up to Cha mod items (min 2), only one of maximum size, with no gp limit.

features.name: Silver Tongue
features.desc: Treat a d20 of 9 or lower on Persuasion or Deception as a 10.

features.name: Unsettling Words
features.desc: Bonus action, spend a Bardic Inspiration on a creature within 60 feet: it subtracts the roll from its next save before your next turn.

features.name: Unfailing Inspiration
features.desc: A creature that adds your Bardic Inspiration and still fails keeps the die.

features.name: Universal Speech
features.desc: Action: up to Cha mod (min 1) creatures within 60 feet understand you for 1 hour. Once per long rest, or spend a spell slot.

features.name: Infectious Inspiration
features.desc: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet succeeds using your Bardic Inspiration: give a free die to another creature within 60 feet that can hear you. Cha mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: command, heroism (1st); hold person, zone of truth (3rd); mass healing word, slow (5th); compulsion, locate creature (7th); commune, dominate person (9th).

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Heavy armor, and Intimidation or Persuasion.

features.name: Voice of Authority
features.desc: When your 1st-level or higher spell targets an ally, that ally can use its reaction to make one weapon attack against a creature you choose.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Order's Demand
features.desc: Action: chosen creatures within 30 feet that see or hear you make a Wis save or are charmed until the end of your next turn or until damaged, and you can make them drop what they hold.

features.name: Embodiment of the Law
features.desc: Cast a 1st-level or higher enchantment spell with a 1-action casting time as a bonus action. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.desc: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 psychic (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Order's Wrath
features.desc: When your Divine Strike damages a creature, curse it until your next turn: the next ally hit on it deals an extra 2d8 psychic.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: heroism, sanctuary (1st); aid, warding bond (3rd); beacon of hope, sending (5th); aura of purity, Otiluke's resilient sphere (7th); greater restoration, Rary's telepathic bond (9th).

features.name: Implement of Peace
features.desc: Proficiency in Insight, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Emboldening Bond
features.desc: Action: bond up to proficiency bonus willing creatures within 30 feet (yourself included) for 10 minutes; while within 30 feet of another bonded creature, each can add 1d4 to one attack, check or save per turn. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Balm of Peace
features.desc: Action: move your speed without provoking; each creature you pass within 5 feet of regains 2d6 + Wis mod HP (min 1), once each.

features.name: Protective Bond
features.desc: When a bonded creature is about to take damage, another bonded creature within 30 feet can use its reaction to teleport within 5 feet of it and take all the damage instead.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.desc: Add Wis mod to cleric cantrip damage.

features.name: Expansive Bond
features.desc: Emboldening and Protective Bond work within 60 feet, and a creature taking damage through Protective Bond has resistance to it.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: faerie fire, sleep (1st); moonbeam, see invisibility (3rd); aura of vitality, Leomund's tiny hut (5th); aura of life, greater invisibility (7th); circle of power, mislead (9th).

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Eyes of Night
features.desc: Darkvision 300 feet, seeing dim light as bright and darkness as dim. Action: share it with up to Wis mod (min 1) willing creatures within 10 feet for 1 hour, once per long rest or by spending a spell slot.

features.name: Vigilant Blessing
features.desc: Action: a creature you touch has advantage on its next initiative roll.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
features.desc: Action: a 30-foot sphere of dim light moves with you for 1 minute; a creature ending its turn in it gains 1d6 + cleric level temporary HP or ends one charmed or frightened effect.

features.name: Steps of Night
features.desc: In dim light or darkness, bonus action: flying speed equal to walking speed for 1 minute. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.desc: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 radiant (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Twilight Shroud
features.desc: You and allies have half cover inside your Twilight Sanctuary.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.desc: Chill touch at 2nd. Always prepared: blindness/deafness, gentle repose (3rd); animate dead, gaseous form (5th); blight, confusion (7th); cloudkill, contagion (9th).

features.name: Halo of Spores
features.desc: Reaction when a creature you can see moves within 10 feet or starts its turn there: Con save against your spell DC or 1d4 necrotic (1d6 at 6th, 1d8 at 10th, 1d10 at 14th).

features.name: Symbiotic Entity
features.desc: Action, spend a Wild Shape use: gain 4 temporary HP per druid level; for 10 minutes (or until those HP are gone or you Wild Shape) Halo of Spores rolls its die twice and your melee weapon hits deal +1d6 necrotic.

features.name: Fungal Infestation
features.desc: Reaction when a Small or Medium beast or humanoid dies within 10 feet: it rises as a zombie with 1 HP for 1 hour, acting after you and only able to make one melee attack. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Spreading Spores
features.desc: While Symbiotic Entity is active, bonus action: a 10-foot cube of spores within 30 feet for 1 minute; a creature entering or starting its turn there makes a Con save or takes your Halo damage (once per turn). You can't use the Halo reaction while it lasts.

features.name: Fungal Body
features.desc: Immune to blinded, deafened, frightened and poisoned; critical hits against you become normal hits unless you're incapacitated.

features.name: Star Map
features.desc: A Tiny star chart that is a druid focus. While holding it: you know guidance, guiding bolt is always prepared, and you can cast guiding bolt without a slot proficiency bonus times per long rest. A 1-hour ceremony during a rest replaces it.

features.name: Starry Form
features.desc: Bonus action, spend a Wild Shape use: glow for 10 minutes (bright 10 feet, dim 10 more) with a constellation. Archer: on activation and as a bonus action each turn, ranged spell attack within 60 feet for 1d8 + Wis radiant. Chalice: when a slotted spell heals, you or a creature within 30 feet regains 1d8 + Wis. Dragon: treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower on Int and Wis checks and concentration saves as 10.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.desc: After a long rest, roll a die: even (Weal) lets you add 1d6, odd (Woe) subtract 1d6, as a reaction to an attack, save or check by a creature within 30 feet. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.desc: Archer and Chalice become 2d8; Dragon grants a 20-foot flying speed with hover; you can switch constellation at the start of each of your turns.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.desc: In Starry Form, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: burning hands, cure wounds (2nd); flaming sphere, scorching ray (3rd); plant growth, revivify (5th); aura of life, fire shield (7th); flame strike, mass cure wounds (9th).

features.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
features.desc: Action, spend a Wild Shape use: a wildfire spirit appears within 30 feet for 1 hour, and creatures within 10 feet of it make a Dex save or take 2d6 fire. Small elemental, AC 13, HP 5 + 5 x druid level, speed 30, fly 30 hover; Flame Seed (spell attack, 60 feet, 1d6 + PB fire); Fiery Teleportation (it and willing creatures within 5 feet teleport 15 feet, then Dex save or 1d6 + PB fire for creatures near where it left). It acts after you and Dodges unless commanded with a bonus action.

features.name: Enhanced Bond
features.desc: While the spirit is summoned, add 1d8 to one damage or healing roll of your fire-damage or healing spells, and your ranged spells can originate from the spirit.

features.name: Cauterizing Flames
features.desc: When a Small or larger creature dies within 30 feet of you or the spirit, a spectral flame stays for 1 minute; reaction when a creature enters it: heal it or deal fire damage, 2d10 + Wis mod. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Blazing Revival
features.desc: When you drop to 0 HP with the spirit within 120 feet, it drops to 0 instead and you regain half your hit points and stand. Once per long rest.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.desc: Psionic Energy dice (d6; d8 at 5th, d10 at 11th, d12 at 17th), twice your proficiency bonus, regained on a long rest; once per short or long rest regain one as a bonus action. Protective Field: reaction, spend a die to reduce damage to you or a creature within 30 feet by the roll + Int (min 1). Psionic Strike: once per turn after a weapon hit on a target within 30 feet, spend a die for force damage equal to the roll + Int. Telekinetic Movement: action, move a Large or smaller loose object or willing creature within 30 feet up to 30 feet (or a Tiny object to or from your hand); once per short or long rest, or spend a die.

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.desc: Psi-Powered Leap: bonus action, flying speed twice your walking speed this turn (once per short or long rest, or spend a die). Telekinetic Thrust: a Psionic Strike target makes a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency + Int) or is knocked prone or moved 10 feet horizontally.

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.desc: Resistance to psychic. If you start your turn charmed or frightened, spend a die to end those effects.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.desc: Bonus action: up to Int mod (min 1) creatures within 30 feet, you included, have half cover for 1 minute. Once per long rest, or spend a die.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.desc: Cast telekinesis without components (Int); while concentrating on it, one weapon attack as a bonus action each turn. Once per long rest, or spend a die.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Smith's tools; speak, read and write Giant.

features.name: Rune Carver
features.desc: Know 2 runes (3 at 7th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th; swap one per level). After a long rest, inscribe each on a different worn or held object. Each invokes once per short or long rest; save DC 8 + proficiency + Con. Cloud: advantage on Sleight of Hand and Deception; reaction to redirect an attack hitting you or a creature within 30 feet to another creature within 30 feet. Fire: double proficiency on tool checks; on a weapon hit, +2d6 fire and Str save or restrained 1 minute taking 2d6 fire each turn (save ends). Frost: advantage on Animal Handling and Intimidation; bonus action, +2 to Str and Con checks and saves for 10 minutes. Stone: advantage on Insight, darkvision 120 feet; reaction when a creature ends its turn within 30 feet, Wis save or charmed, speed 0 and incapacitated for 1 minute (save ends). Hill (7th): advantage on saves against poison and poison resistance; bonus action, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing for 1 minute. Storm (7th): advantage on Arcana and can't be surprised; bonus action for 1 minute, reaction to give advantage or disadvantage to a roll within 60 feet.

features.name: Giant's Might
features.desc: Bonus action, 1 minute: become Large if there's room, advantage on Str checks and saves, and once per turn +1d6 on a weapon or unarmed hit. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Runic Shield
features.desc: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet is hit: the attacker rerolls the d20. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Great Stature
features.desc: Grow 3d4 inches; Giant's Might extra damage becomes 1d8.

features.name: Master of Runes
features.desc: Each rune can be invoked twice per short or long rest.

features.name: Runic Juggernaut
features.desc: Giant's Might deals 1d10 and can make you Huge with +5 feet reach.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
features.desc: Insight, Medicine and the herbalism kit, plus a mercy mask.

features.name: Hand of Healing
features.desc: Action, 1 ki: touch a creature to restore Martial Arts die + Wis HP. In Flurry of Blows, replace one strike with it at no ki.

features.name: Hand of Harm
features.desc: Once per turn on an unarmed hit, 1 ki: extra necrotic equal to Martial Arts die + Wis.

features.name: Physician's Touch
features.desc: Hand of Healing also ends one disease or blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned or stunned. Hand of Harm can poison the target until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
features.desc: In Flurry of Blows, replace each strike with Hand of Healing for free, and use Hand of Harm on a Flurry strike without ki (still once per turn).

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
features.desc: Action, 5 ki: a creature dead under 24 hours returns with 4d10 + Wis HP, free of blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned and stunned. Once per long rest.

features.name: Arms of the Astral Self
features.desc: Bonus action, 1 ki, 10 minutes: chosen creatures within 10 feet make a Dex save or take two Martial Arts dice of force. While active, use Wis for Str checks and saves; unarmed strikes with the arms have +5 feet reach on your turn, can use Wis for attack and damage, and deal force.

features.name: Visage of the Astral Self
features.desc: Bonus action (or with the arms), 1 ki, 10 minutes: see normally in magical and nonmagical darkness to 120 feet, advantage on Insight and Intimidation, and speak to only one creature within 60 feet or be heard to 600 feet.

features.name: Body of the Astral Self
features.desc: With arms and visage active: reaction to reduce acid, cold, fire, force, lightning or thunder damage by 1d10 + Wis (min 1), and once per turn an arms hit deals an extra Martial Arts die.

features.name: Awakened Astral Self
features.desc: Bonus action, 5 ki: arms, visage and body for 10 minutes, plus +2 AC and three attacks instead of two with Extra Attack when all use the arms.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: guiding bolt, heroism (3rd); enhance ability, magic weapon (5th); haste, protection from energy (9th); compulsion, freedom of movement (13th); commune, flame strike (17th).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: Peerless Athlete: bonus action, 10 minutes of advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics, double carrying capacity and +10 feet on jumps. Inspiring Smite: bonus action right after a Divine Smite, share 2d8 + paladin level temporary HP among creatures within 30 feet.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.desc: +10 feet walking speed; allies starting their turn within 5 feet (10 feet at 18th) get +10 feet that turn, if you aren't incapacitated.

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.desc: Reaction when you or a creature within 10 feet is hit: add Cha mod (min 1) to its AC; if that makes it miss, make one weapon attack against the attacker. Cha mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Living Legend
features.desc: Bonus action, 1 minute: advantage on Charisma checks, once per turn turn a missed weapon attack into a hit, and reaction to reroll a failed save. Once per long rest, or spend a 5th-level slot.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: alarm, detect magic (3rd); moonbeam, see invisibility (5th); counterspell, nondetection (9th); aura of purity, banishment (13th); hold monster, scrying (17th).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: Watcher's Will: action, you and up to Cha mod (min 1) creatures within 30 feet have advantage on Int, Wis and Cha saves for 1 minute. Abjure the Extraplanar: action, aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends within 30 feet that hear you make a Wis save or are turned for 1 minute or until damaged.

features.name: Aura of the Sentinel
features.desc: While not incapacitated, you and chosen creatures within 10 feet (30 at 18th) add your proficiency bonus to initiative.

features.name: Vigilant Rebuke
features.desc: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet succeeds on an Int, Wis or Cha save: the creature that forced it takes 2d8 + Cha mod force.

features.name: Mortal Bulwark
features.desc: Bonus action, 1 minute: truesight 120 feet, advantage on attacks against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends, and on a damaging hit the target makes a Cha save against your spell DC or is banished to its native plane (a success makes it immune for 24 hours). Once per long rest, or spend a 5th-level slot.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.desc: Weapon hits deal +1d4 psychic, once per turn per target (1d6 at 11th).

features.name: Fey Wanderer Magic
features.desc: Known extra spells: charm person (3rd), misty step (5th), dispel magic (9th), dimension door (13th), mislead (17th). Also a cosmetic Feywild gift.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
features.desc: Add Wis mod (min +1) to Charisma checks; proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Beguiling Twist
features.desc: Advantage on saves against charmed and frightened. Reaction when you or a creature within 120 feet succeeds on such a save: another creature within 120 feet makes a Wis save or is charmed or frightened by you for 1 minute (save ends).

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.desc: Know summon fey (not counted, no material component); cast it once per long rest without a slot. Any casting can skip concentration, lasting 1 minute.

features.name: Misty Wanderer
features.desc: Cast misty step without a slot Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, and any misty step can bring a willing creature within 5 feet along.

features.name: Gathered Swarm
features.desc: Once per turn right after you hit with an attack: the target takes 1d6 piercing; or it makes a Str save against your spell DC or is moved 15 feet horizontally; or you move 5 feet horizontally.

features.name: Swarmkeeper Magic
features.desc: Mage hand, plus known extra spells: faerie fire (3rd), web (5th), gaseous form (9th), arcane eye (13th), insect plague (17th).

features.name: Writhing Tide
features.desc: Bonus action: 10-foot flying speed with hover for 1 minute. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Mighty Swarm
features.desc: Gathered Swarm deals 1d8; a creature failing the move save can also be knocked prone; moving yourself grants half cover until your next turn.

features.name: Swarming Dispersal
features.desc: Reaction when you take damage: resistance to it, then teleport up to 30 feet. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Whispers of the Dead
features.desc: After a short or long rest, gain one skill or tool proficiency you lack until you choose another.

features.name: Wails from the Grave
features.desc: Right after Sneak Attack damage on your turn, a second creature within 30 feet of the first takes necrotic damage from half your Sneak Attack dice (round up). Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Tokens of the Departed
features.desc: Reaction when a creature dies within 30 feet: create a soul trinket (max proficiency bonus). While carrying one, advantage on death saves and Con saves. Destroy one to use Wails from the Grave without a use, or as an action to ask its spirit one question.

features.name: Ghost Walk
features.desc: Bonus action, 10 minutes: 10-foot fly speed with hover, attacks against you have disadvantage, move through creatures and objects (1d10 force if you end inside one). Once per long rest, or destroy a soul trinket.

features.name: Death's Friend
features.desc: Wails from the Grave damages both creatures; if you have no soul trinket at the end of a long rest, one appears.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.desc: Psionic Energy dice (d6; d8 at 5th, d10 at 11th, d12 at 17th), twice your proficiency bonus, regained on a long rest; once per short or long rest regain one as a bonus action. Psi-Bolstered Knack: when you fail a proficient skill or tool check, add a die, spending it only if that turns it into a success. Psychic Whispers: action, telepathy within 1 mile with up to proficiency bonus creatures for hours equal to a die roll; the first use after a long rest is free.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.desc: When you take the Attack action, attack with a psychic blade (simple melee, finesse, thrown 60 feet): 1d6 + the ability mod psychic. Then a second blade as a bonus action for 1d4 if your other hand is free.

features.name: Soul Blades
features.desc: Homing Strikes: on a Psychic Blades miss, add a die and spend it only if it hits. Psychic Teleportation: bonus action, spend a die and teleport 10 x the roll feet to a space you can see.

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.desc: Action: invisible for 1 hour, ending after you deal damage or force a save. Once per long rest, or spend a die.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.desc: When Psychic Blades deal Sneak Attack, the target makes a Wis save (DC 8 + proficiency + Dex) or is stunned for 1 minute (save ends). Once per long rest, or spend three dice.

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.desc: Known extra spells, swappable on level up for a divination or enchantment of the same level from the sorcerer, warlock or wizard list: arms of Hadar, dissonant whispers, mind sliver (1st); calm emotions, detect thoughts (3rd); hunger of Hadar, sending (5th); Evard's black tentacles, summon aberration (7th); Rary's telepathic bond, telekinesis (9th).

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.desc: Bonus action, a creature within 30 feet: telepathy within Cha mod miles (min 1) for sorcerer level minutes, in a shared language.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.desc: Cast a Psionic Spell by spending sorcery points equal to its level instead of a slot, with no verbal, somatic or unconsumed material components.

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.desc: Resistance to psychic; advantage on saves against charmed and frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.desc: Bonus action, 10 minutes, one benefit per sorcery point: see invisible creatures within 60 feet; flying speed equal to walking with hover; swim speed twice walking and water breathing; squeeze through 1-inch gaps and escape nonmagical restraints or grapples for 5 feet of movement.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.desc: Action: teleport up to 120 feet; creatures within 30 feet of where you left make a Str save or take 3d10 force and are pulled toward that space, half and no pull on a success. Once per long rest, or 5 sorcery points.

features.name: Clockwork Magic
features.desc: Known extra spells, swappable on level up for an abjuration or transmutation of the same level from the sorcerer, warlock or wizard list: alarm, protection from evil and good (1st); aid, lesser restoration (3rd); dispel magic, protection from energy (5th); freedom of movement, summon construct (7th); greater restoration, wall of force (9th).

features.name: Restore Balance
features.desc: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet is about to roll a d20 with advantage or disadvantage: it rolls normally. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.desc: Action, 1 to 5 sorcery points: a ward of that many d8s on you or a creature within 30 feet, lasting until your next long rest or new ward; the warded creature spends dice to reduce damage it takes.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.desc: Bonus action, 1 minute: attacks against you can't have advantage, and you treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower on attacks, checks and saves as 10. Once per long rest, or 5 sorcery points.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.desc: Action, a 30-foot cube from you: restore up to 100 HP split among chosen creatures, repair damaged objects entirely inside, and end spells of 6th level or lower on chosen creatures and objects. Once per long rest, or 7 sorcery points.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.desc: Added to your warlock list: create or destroy water, thunderwave (1st); gust of wind, silence (2nd); lightning bolt, sleet storm (3rd); control water, summon elemental (water only) (4th); Bigby's hand, cone of cold (5th).

features.name: Tentacle of the Deeps
features.desc: Bonus action: a 10-foot tentacle at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute; melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet of it for 1d8 cold (2d8 at 10th) and -10 feet speed until your next turn. Bonus action each turn: move it 30 feet and attack again. Proficiency bonus summons per long rest.

features.name: Gift of the Sea
features.desc: Swim speed 40 feet and water breathing.

features.name: Oceanic Soul
features.desc: Resistance to cold. While fully submerged, you and other submerged creatures understand each other's speech.

features.name: Guardian Coil
features.desc: Reaction when you or a creature within 10 feet of the tentacle takes damage: reduce it by 1d8 (2d8 at 10th).

features.name: Grasping Tentacles
features.desc: Know Evard's black tentacles (not counted), castable once per long rest without a slot; casting it gives temporary HP equal to your warlock level, and damage can't break concentration on it.

features.name: Fathomless Plunge
features.desc: Action: you and up to five willing creatures within 30 feet teleport up to 1 mile to a body of water you've seen (pond or larger) or within 30 feet of it. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.desc: Choose a patron kind: dao (earth), djinni (air), efreeti (fire) or marid (water). Added to your warlock list: detect evil and good, phantasmal force, create food and water, phantasmal killer, creation, and wish at 9th; plus by kind, dao sanctuary, spike growth, meld into stone, stone shape, wall of stone; djinni thunderwave, gust of wind, wind wall, greater invisibility, seeming; efreeti burning hands, scorching ray, fireball, fire shield, flame strike; marid fog cloud, blur, sleet storm, control water, cone of cold.

features.name: Genie's Vessel
features.desc: A Tiny vessel (AC your spell DC, HP warlock level + proficiency, immune to poison and psychic) that is your warlock focus; replace it with a 1-hour ceremony during a rest. Bottled Respite: action, enter its 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high interior for up to twice your proficiency bonus in hours, hearing outside; once per long rest. Genie's Wrath: once per turn on an attack hit, extra damage equal to your proficiency bonus, bludgeoning (dao), thunder (djinni), fire (efreeti) or cold (marid).

features.name: Elemental Gift
features.desc: Resistance to your patron's damage type. Bonus action: 30-foot flying speed with hover for 10 minutes, proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Sanctuary Vessel
features.desc: Bring up to five willing creatures within 30 feet into the vessel and eject them as a bonus action. Ten minutes inside counts as a short rest, and Hit Dice spent there heal an extra amount equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Limited Wish
features.desc: Action: produce the effect of any spell of 6th level or lower with a 1-action casting time, ignoring its requirements and costly components. Usable again after 1d4 long rests.

features.name: Training in War and Song
features.desc: Light armor, one one-handed melee weapon type, and Performance.

features.name: Bladesong
features.desc: Bonus action, 1 minute, without medium or heavy armor or a shield: + Int mod (min 1) to AC and to concentration saves, +10 feet walking speed, advantage on Acrobatics. Ends if incapacitated, you don such armor or a shield, or attack two-handed. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: Attack twice with the Attack action, and one attack can be a cantrip.

features.name: Song of Defense
features.desc: During Bladesong, reaction when you take damage: spend a spell slot to reduce it by 5 x the slot's level.

features.name: Song of Victory
features.desc: During Bladesong, add Int mod (min 1) to melee weapon damage.

features.name: Wizardly Quill
features.desc: Bonus action: create an inkless Tiny quill; copying spells with it takes 2 minutes per spell level, and it can erase its own writing within 5 feet as a bonus action.

features.name: Awakened Spellbook
features.desc: While held: it is your focus; a slotted wizard spell can swap its damage type for one from another spell of the same level in the book; once per long rest cast a ritual at its normal casting time. Replace the book over a short rest with the quill.

features.name: Manifest Mind
features.desc: Bonus action: the book's spectral mind appears within 60 feet (dim light 10 feet, darkvision 60, shares senses with you, moves 30 feet as a bonus action). Proficiency bonus times per long rest, cast a wizard spell from its space. Ends beyond 300 feet, on dispel magic, or when dismissed. Once per long rest, or spend a spell slot.

features.name: Master Scrivener
features.desc: After a long rest, make a scroll of a 1st- or 2nd-level, 1-action spell from your book that casts one level higher, readable only by you and fading after your next long rest. Spell scrolls cost half the gold and time with the quill.

features.name: One with the Word
features.desc: Advantage on Arcana while carrying the book. Once per long rest, reaction when you take damage while the mind is manifested: dismiss it to negate the damage; the book loses spells totaling at least 3d6 levels for 1d6 long rests (or you drop to 0 HP if it can't cover the cost).

features.name: Spirit Seeker
features.desc: Cast beast sense and speak with animals as rituals only.

features.name: Totem Spirit
features.desc: Choose a totem (with a physical totem object). Bear: while raging, resistance to all damage except psychic. Eagle: while raging, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage and you can Dash as a bonus action. Wolf: while raging, friends have advantage on melee attacks against hostile creatures within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Aspect of the Beast
features.desc: Choose a totem: Bear, double carrying capacity and advantage on Str checks to push, pull, lift or break; Eagle, see up to 1 mile in fine detail and dim light doesn't hinder Perception; Wolf, track at a fast pace and move stealthily at a normal pace.

features.name: Spirit Walker
features.desc: Cast commune with nature as a ritual only.

features.name: Totemic Attunement
features.desc: Choose a totem: Bear, while raging, hostile creatures within 5 feet that can see or hear you (and can be frightened) have disadvantage attacking anyone but you; Eagle, while raging, flying speed equal to walking speed in bursts (you fall if you end your turn aloft); Wolf, while raging, bonus action to knock a Large or smaller creature prone after hitting it with a melee weapon.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Medium armor, shields and martial weapons.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.desc: A creature with your Bardic Inspiration can add the die to a weapon damage roll, or use its reaction to add it to AC against an attack after seeing the roll.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Battle Magic
features.desc: When you use your action to cast a bard spell, make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: command, identify (1st); augury, suggestion (3rd); nondetection, speak with dead (5th); arcane eye, confusion (7th); legend lore, scrying (9th).

features.name: Blessings of Knowledge
features.desc: Two languages, and proficiency with double bonus in two of Arcana, History, Nature or Religion.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
features.desc: Action: proficiency with one skill or tool for 10 minutes.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts
features.desc: Action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wis save: on a failure you read its surface thoughts for 1 minute and can end it to cast suggestion on it without a slot (it automatically fails); on a success you can't target it again until a long rest.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.desc: Add Wis mod to cleric cantrip damage.

features.name: Visions of the Past
features.desc: Meditate (concentration, up to your Wis score in minutes) for visions: an object's recent owners and how they gained and lost it, or significant events in your surroundings over the last Wis-score days. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: burning hands, faerie fire (1st); flaming sphere, scorching ray (3rd); daylight, fireball (5th); guardian of faith, wall of fire (7th); flame strike, scrying (9th).

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.desc: Light, not counted against your cantrips.

features.name: Warding Flare
features.desc: Reaction when a creature within 30 feet attacks you: impose disadvantage (creatures that can't be blinded are immune). Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
features.desc: Action: dispel magical darkness within 30 feet; hostile creatures within 30 feet make a Con save, 2d10 + cleric level radiant, half on a success.

features.name: Improved Flare
features.desc: Warding Flare also protects creatures within 30 feet that are attacked.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.desc: Add Wis mod to cleric cantrip damage.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.desc: Action, 1 minute: bright light 60 feet and dim 30 more; enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saves against fire or radiant spells.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: animal friendship, speak with animals (1st); barkskin, spike growth (3rd); plant growth, wind wall (5th); dominate beast, grasping vine (7th); insect plague, tree stride (9th).

features.name: Acolyte of Nature
features.desc: One druid cantrip (as a cleric cantrip, not counted) and one of Animal Handling, Nature or Survival.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.desc: Heavy armor.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
features.desc: Action: beasts and plants within 30 feet that see you make a Wis save or are charmed for 1 minute or until damaged, friendly to you and those you choose.

features.name: Dampen Elements
features.desc: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet takes acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage: grant resistance to it.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.desc: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 cold, fire or lightning (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Master of Nature
features.desc: Bonus action: command creatures charmed by your Channel Divinity on their next turns.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: fog cloud, thunderwave (1st); gust of wind, shatter (3rd); call lightning, sleet storm (5th); control water, ice storm (7th); destructive wave, insect plague (9th).

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Wrath of the Storm
features.desc: Reaction when a creature within 5 feet hits you: Dex save, 2d8 lightning or thunder, half on a success. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
features.desc: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, deal the maximum instead.

features.name: Thunderbolt Strike
features.desc: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, push it up to 10 feet.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.desc: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 thunder (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Stormborn
features.desc: Flying speed equal to walking speed when not underground or indoors.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: charm person, disguise self (1st); mirror image, pass without trace (3rd); blink, dispel magic (5th); dimension door, polymorph (7th); dominate person, modify memory (9th).

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.desc: Action: a willing creature you touch (not you) has advantage on Stealth for 1 hour.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
features.desc: Action: an illusory double within 30 feet for 1 minute (concentration), movable 30 feet as a bonus action within 120 feet. You can cast spells from its space, and you have advantage attacking a creature when you and the double are both within 5 feet of it.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
features.desc: Action: invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack or cast.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.desc: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 poison (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.desc: Invoke Duplicity makes up to four doubles.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: divine favor, shield of faith (1st); magic weapon, spiritual weapon (3rd); crusader's mantle, spirit guardians (5th); freedom of movement, stoneskin (7th); flame strike, hold monster (9th).

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: War Priest
features.desc: When you take the Attack action, one weapon attack as a bonus action. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
features.desc: +10 to your attack roll after seeing it.

features.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
features.desc: Reaction: +10 to an attack roll by a creature within 30 feet after seeing it.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.desc: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's type (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.desc: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.desc: Wild Shape as a bonus action. While transformed, bonus action to spend a spell slot and regain 1d8 HP per slot level.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.desc: Wild Shape into beasts up to CR 1 (ignoring the Max CR column); from 6th level up to druid level / 3.

features.name: Primal Strike
features.desc: Attacks in beast form count as magical.

features.name: Elemental Wild Shape
features.desc: Spend two Wild Shape uses to become an air, earth, fire or water elemental.

features.name: Thousand Forms
features.desc: Cast alter self at will.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.desc: Learn three maneuvers (two more at 7th, 10th and 15th, swapping one each time); one maneuver per attack. Four d8 superiority dice (five at 7th, six at 15th), regained on a short or long rest. Save DC 8 + proficiency + Str or Dex. Maneuvers: Commander's Strike, Disarming Attack, Distracting Strike, Evasive Footwork, Feinting Attack, Goading Attack, Lunging Attack, Maneuvering Attack, Menacing Attack, Parry, Precision Attack, Pushing Attack, Rally, Riposte, Sweeping Attack, Trip Attack.

features.name: Student of War
features.desc: Proficiency with one artisan's tool.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.desc: After 1 minute observing or talking with a creature outside combat, learn whether it is your equal, superior or inferior in two of: Str, Dex, Con, AC, current HP, total class levels, fighter levels.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
features.desc: Superiority dice become d10s (d12s at 18th).

features.name: Relentless
features.desc: If you roll initiative with no superiority dice, regain one.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.desc: Wizard spells with Intelligence: 2 cantrips (3 at 10th) and spells known growing from 3 to 13, mostly abjuration and evocation (any school at 3rd, 8th, 14th and 20th). One-third caster slots up to 4th level.

features.name: Weapon Bond
features.desc: A 1-hour ritual bonds up to two weapons: you can't be disarmed of them unless incapacitated, and you can summon one to your hand as a bonus action from the same plane.

features.name: War Magic
features.desc: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, one weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.desc: A creature you hit with a weapon has disadvantage on its next save against your spell before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.desc: When you Action Surge, teleport up to 30 feet before or after the extra action.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.desc: When you use your action to cast any spell, one weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.desc: Action, 2 ki: cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace or silence without material components. You know minor illusion.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.desc: In dim light or darkness, bonus action: teleport up to 60 feet to another dim or dark space, then advantage on your first melee attack this turn.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.desc: In dim light or darkness, action: invisible until you attack, cast a spell or enter bright light.
