features.name: Opportunist
features.desc: Reaction when a creature within 5 feet is hit by someone else's attack: make a melee attack against it.

features.name: Disciple of the Elements
features.desc: Know Elemental Attunement plus one discipline (one more at 6th, 11th and 17th, swapping one each time). Spells from disciplines need no material components; from 5th level spend extra ki to upcast (max ki per spell 3 at 5th, 4 at 9th, 5 at 13th, 6 at 17th). Disciplines: Elemental Attunement (minor elemental tricks within 30 feet); Fangs of the Fire Snake (1 ki: +10 feet unarmed reach dealing fire, +1 ki for +1d10 fire); Fist of Four Thunders (2 ki: thunderwave); Fist of Unbroken Air (2 ki: Str save, 3d10 bludgeoning +1d10 per extra ki, push 20 feet and prone; half only on success); Rush of the Gale Spirits (2 ki: gust of wind); Shape the Flowing River (1 ki: reshape ice and water in a 30-foot area); Sweeping Cinder Strike (2 ki: burning hands); Water Whip (2 ki: Dex save, 3d10 bludgeoning +1d10 per extra ki, prone or pull 25 feet; half only on success); at 6th Clench of the North Wind (3 ki: hold person) and Gong of the Summit (3 ki: shatter); at 11th Flames of the Phoenix (4 ki: fireball), Mist Stance (4 ki: gaseous form on yourself) and Ride the Wind (4 ki: fly on yourself); at 17th Breath of Winter (6 ki: cone of cold), Eternal Mountain Defense (5 ki: stoneskin on yourself), River of Hungry Flame (5 ki: wall of fire) and Wave of Rolling Earth (6 ki: wall of stone).

features.name: Oath Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: ensnaring strike, speak with animals (3rd); misty step, moonbeam (5th); plant growth, protection from energy (9th); ice storm, stoneskin (13th); commune with nature, tree stride (17th).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: Nature's Wrath: action, a creature within 10 feet makes a Str or Dex save (its choice) or is restrained by vines, repeating the save each turn. Turn the Faithless: action, fey and fiends within 30 feet that hear you make a Wis save or are turned for 1 minute or until damaged, revealing any disguised true form.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.desc: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet (30 at 18th) have resistance to damage from spells.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.desc: Once per long rest, when reduced to 0 HP without dying outright, drop to 1 instead. You suffer no drawbacks of age and can't be aged magically.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.desc: Action, 1 minute: regain 10 HP at the start of each turn, cast 1-action paladin spells as a bonus action, and enemies within 10 feet have disadvantage on saves against your paladin spells and Channel Divinity. Once per long rest.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: bane, hunter's mark (3rd); hold person, misty step (5th); haste, protection from energy (9th); banishment, dimension door (13th); hold monster, scrying (17th).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: Abjure Enemy: action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wis save (fiends and undead with disadvantage) or is frightened with speed 0 for 1 minute or until damaged; on a success its speed is halved for that time. Vow of Enmity: bonus action, advantage on attacks against a creature within 10 feet for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 HP.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.desc: When you hit with an opportunity attack, move up to half your speed as part of that reaction without provoking.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.desc: Reaction when your Vow of Enmity target attacks: a melee weapon attack against it if in range.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.desc: Action, 1 hour: 60-foot flying speed and a 30-foot aura; enemies entering it or starting their turn there in battle make a Wis save or are frightened for 1 minute or until damaged, and attacks against them have advantage. Once per long rest.

features.name: Ranger's Companion
features.desc: A Medium or smaller beast of CR 1/4 or lower; add your proficiency bonus to its AC, attacks, damage and proficient saves and skills; HP is the higher of its own or 4 x ranger level. It acts on your initiative and Dodges unless you use your action to command Attack, Dash, Disengage or Help (with Extra Attack you also make one weapon attack when commanding Attack). Replace it with 8 hours of bonding.

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.desc: On a turn it doesn't attack, bonus action to command Dash, Disengage or Help; its attacks count as magical.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.desc: When commanded to Attack, it makes two attacks or uses Multiattack.

features.name: Share Spells
features.desc: A spell you cast targeting yourself can also affect your companion within 30 feet.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Disguise kit and poisoner's kit.

features.name: Assassinate
features.desc: Advantage on attacks against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet in the combat, and hits against surprised creatures are critical hits.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.desc: Spend seven days and 25 gp to build a false identity that others believe while you wear it, until given obvious reason not to.

features.name: Impostor
features.desc: After 3 hours of study, mimic a person's speech, writing and behavior; advantage on Deception to avoid detection by wary observers.

features.name: Death Strike
features.desc: When you hit a surprised creature, it makes a Con save (DC 8 + Dex + proficiency) or the attack's damage is doubled.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.desc: Wizard spells with Intelligence: mage hand plus two cantrips (another at 10th) and spells known growing from 3 to 13, mostly enchantment and illusion (any school at 3rd, 8th, 14th and 20th). One-third caster slots up to 4th level.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.desc: Your mage hand can be invisible, stow or retrieve objects in another creature's container, and use thieves' tools at range; Sleight of Hand vs Perception to go unnoticed. Control it with your Cunning Action bonus action.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.desc: If you are hidden from a creature when you cast a spell on it, it has disadvantage on its saves against the spell this turn.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.desc: Bonus action: advantage on attacks this turn against a creature within 5 feet of your mage hand.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.desc: Reaction right after a creature casts a spell targeting or including you: it saves with its casting ability against your spell DC; on a failure the spell doesn't affect you and, if it is 1st level or higher and of a level you can cast, you know it for 8 hours while the caster can't cast it. Once per long rest.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.desc: Once per turn after you cast a 1st-level or higher sorcerer spell, the DM can have you roll a d20; on a 1, roll on the d100 Wild Magic Surge table (spells it produces ignore Metamagic and concentration).

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.desc: Advantage on one attack, check or save; regained after a long rest, or when the DM has you roll on the surge table after a 1st-level or higher sorcerer spell.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.desc: Reaction, 2 sorcery points: add or subtract 1d4 to another visible creature's attack, check or save after the roll.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.desc: Roll twice on the surge table and choose.

features.name: Spell Bombardment
features.desc: Once per turn, when a spell damage die rolls its maximum, roll one such die again and add it.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.desc: Added to your warlock list: faerie fire, sleep (1st); calm emotions, phantasmal force (2nd); blink, plant growth (3rd); dominate beast, greater invisibility (4th); dominate person, seeming (5th).

features.name: Fey Presence
features.desc: Action: creatures in a 10-foot cube from you make a Wis save or are charmed or frightened (your choice) until the end of your next turn. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.desc: Reaction when you take damage: invisible and teleport up to 60 feet, until your next turn or until you attack or cast. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.desc: Immune to charm; reaction when a creature tries to charm you: it makes a Wis save or is charmed by you for 1 minute or until damaged.

features.name: Dark Delirium
features.desc: Action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wis save or is charmed or frightened for 1 minute (concentration, ends if damaged), lost in an illusory realm seeing only you. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.desc: Added to your warlock list: dissonant whispers, Tasha's hideous laughter (1st); detect thoughts, phantasmal force (2nd); clairvoyance, sending (3rd); dominate beast, Evard's black tentacles (4th); dominate person, telekinesis (5th).

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.desc: Speak telepathically to any creature within 30 feet that understands a language.

features.name: Entropic Ward
features.desc: Reaction when attacked: impose disadvantage; if it misses, your next attack against it before the end of your next turn has advantage. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.desc: Your thoughts can't be read unless you allow it; resistance to psychic, and a creature that deals you psychic damage takes the same amount.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.desc: Action: touch an incapacitated humanoid to charm it until remove curse, the condition is removed, or you use this again; telepathy with it on the same plane.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.desc: Copying abjuration spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.desc: When you cast a 1st-level or higher abjuration spell, create a ward (HP 2 x wizard level + Int, once per long rest) that takes damage for you; each later 1st-level or higher abjuration spell restores 2 x spell level HP to it.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.desc: Reaction when a creature within 30 feet takes damage: your ward absorbs it.

features.name: Improved Abjuration
features.desc: Add your proficiency bonus to ability checks made as part of abjuration spells (counterspell, dispel magic).

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.desc: Advantage on saves against spells and resistance to spell damage.

features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.desc: Copying conjuration spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Minor Conjuration
features.desc: Action: conjure a nonmagical object you've seen (up to 3 feet per side and 10 pounds) within 10 feet, glowing dimly; it lasts 1 hour or until it deals or takes damage.

features.name: Benign Transposition
features.desc: Action: teleport 30 feet, or swap places with a willing Small or Medium creature. Once per long rest, or after you cast a 1st-level or higher conjuration spell.

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.desc: Damage can't break your concentration on conjuration spells.

features.name: Durable Summons
features.desc: Creatures you summon or create with conjuration spells have 30 temporary HP.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.desc: Copying divination spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Portent
features.desc: After a long rest roll two d20s; before a roll by you or a creature you can see, replace it with one of them (once per turn). Unused ones are lost at the next long rest.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.desc: When you cast a 2nd-level or higher divination spell with a slot, regain a slot of a lower level (max 5th).

features.name: The Third Eye
features.desc: Action, until incapacitated or a rest: darkvision 60 feet, see into the Ethereal Plane within 60 feet, read any language, or see invisible things within 10 feet. Once per rest.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.desc: Portent rolls three d20s.

features.name: Enchantment Savant
features.desc: Copying enchantment spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Hypnotic Gaze
features.desc: Action, a creature within 5 feet that sees or hears you makes a Wis save or is charmed, speed 0 and incapacitated until the end of your next turn; extend it with your action each turn. Ends if you move away, it loses sight and sound of you, or it takes damage. Once per long rest per creature.

features.name: Instinctive Charm
features.desc: Reaction when a creature within 30 feet attacks you and another creature is in range: Wis save or it attacks the creature closest to it instead (a success makes it immune until a long rest).

features.name: Split Enchantment
features.desc: A 1st-level or higher enchantment spell that targets one creature can target a second.

features.name: Alter Memories
features.desc: A creature you charm with an enchantment can be left unaware of it; once before the spell ends, action: Int save or it forgets up to 1 + Cha mod hours of the charmed time.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.desc: Copying illusion spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Improved Minor Illusion
features.desc: Learn minor illusion (or another wizard cantrip if you know it), not counted; it can make a sound and an image at once.

features.name: Malleable Illusions
features.desc: Action: change an illusion of 1 minute or longer that you can see, within its normal parameters.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.desc: Reaction when attacked: the attack automatically misses. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.desc: Bonus action while a 1st-level or higher illusion spell lasts: make one inanimate, nonmagical object in it real for 1 minute (it can't directly harm anyone).

features.name: Necromancy Savant
features.desc: Copying necromancy spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Grim Harvest
features.desc: Once per turn, when your 1st-level or higher spell kills creatures (not constructs or undead), regain 2 x spell level HP (3 x for necromancy).

features.name: Undead Thralls
features.desc: Add animate dead to your book; it targets one extra corpse, and your undead gain HP equal to your wizard level and add your proficiency bonus to weapon damage.

features.name: Inured to Undeath
features.desc: Resistance to necrotic, and your hit point maximum can't be reduced.

features.name: Command Undead
features.desc: Action, an undead within 60 feet makes a Cha save or obeys you until you use this again (Int 8+ has advantage; Int 12+ repeats the save each hour). A success makes it immune.

features.name: Transmutation Savant
features.desc: Copying transmutation spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Minor Alchemy
features.desc: Transform wood, stone (not gems), iron, copper or silver into another of those, 1 cubic foot per 10 minutes, for 1 hour or until your concentration ends.

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.desc: 8 hours to make a stone granting its holder one of: darkvision 60 feet, +10 feet speed while unencumbered, Con save proficiency, or resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder. Change it when you cast a 1st-level or higher transmutation spell; a new stone ends the old.

features.name: Shapechanger
features.desc: Add polymorph to your book; cast it on yourself without a slot into a beast of CR 1 or lower, once per short or long rest.

features.name: Master Transmuter
features.desc: Action, destroy your stone (remake after a long rest) for one: transmute a nonmagical object up to a 5-foot cube into one of equal or lesser value (10 minutes); remove curses, diseases and poisons and restore all HP to a creature you touch; raise dead without a slot; or reduce a willing creature's apparent age by 3d10 years (minimum 13).

features.name: Battlerager Armor
features.desc: Dwarves only (DM may lift). Spiked armor (medium, AC 14 + Dex max 2, 75 gp) is a weapon for you: while raging, a bonus-action spike attack for 1d4 + Str piercing, and a successful grapple from the Attack action deals 3 piercing.

features.name: Reckless Abandon
features.desc: Reckless Attack while raging gives temporary HP equal to your Con mod (min 1), lost when the rage ends.

features.name: Battlerager Charge
features.desc: Dash as a bonus action while raging.

features.name: Spiked Retribution
features.desc: While raging in spiked armor and not incapacitated, a creature within 5 feet that hits you with a melee attack takes 3 piercing.

features.name: Rallying Cry
features.desc: When you use Second Wind, up to three allies within 60 feet who see or hear you regain HP equal to your fighter level.

features.name: Royal Envoy
features.desc: Persuasion proficiency (or one of Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation, Performance) and double proficiency on Persuasion.

features.name: Inspiring Surge
features.desc: When you Action Surge, an ally within 60 feet who sees or hears you can use its reaction for one weapon attack (two allies at 18th).

features.name: Bulwark
features.desc: When you use Indomitable on an Int, Wis or Cha save, an ally within 60 feet who failed against the same effect and sees or hears you also rerolls.

features.name: Touch of Death
features.desc: When you reduce a creature within 5 feet to 0 HP, gain temporary HP equal to Wis mod + monk level (min 1).

features.name: Hour of Reaping
features.desc: Action: creatures within 30 feet that see you make a Wis save or are frightened until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Mastery of Death
features.desc: When reduced to 0 HP, spend 1 ki to drop to 1 instead.

features.name: Touch of the Long Death
features.desc: Action, spend 1 to 10 ki: a creature within 5 feet makes a Con save, 2d10 necrotic per ki, half on a success.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: command, compelled duel (3rd); warding bond, zone of truth (5th); aura of vitality, spirit guardians (9th); banishment, guardian of faith (13th); circle of power, geas (17th).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: Champion Challenge: bonus action, chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Wis save or can't willingly move more than 30 feet from you. Turn the Tide: bonus action, chosen creatures within 30 feet at half HP or less regain 1d6 + Cha mod (min 1).

features.name: Divine Allegiance
features.desc: Reaction when a creature within 5 feet takes damage: you take it instead; it can't be reduced.

features.name: Unyielding Spirit
features.desc: Advantage on saves against paralyzed and stunned.

features.name: Exalted Champion
features.desc: Action, 1 hour: resistance to nonmagical weapon damage; allies within 30 feet have advantage on death saves, and you and they have advantage on Wis saves. Once per long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.desc: Added to your warlock list: false life, ray of sickness (1st); blindness/deafness, silence (2nd); feign death, speak with dead (3rd); aura of life, death ward (4th); contagion, legend lore (5th).

features.name: Among the Dead
features.desc: Learn spare the dying; advantage on saves against disease. An undead that targets you directly makes a Wis save or must pick another target (a success, or your attacking it, makes it immune for 24 hours).

features.name: Defy Death
features.desc: When you succeed on a death save or stabilize a creature with spare the dying, regain 1d8 + Con mod HP. Once per long rest.

features.name: Undying Nature
features.desc: Hold your breath indefinitely; no need for food, water or sleep; age one year per ten and immune to magical aging.

features.name: Indestructible Life
features.desc: Bonus action: regain 1d8 + warlock level HP and reattach a severed part you hold in place. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: false life, ray of sickness (1st); blindness/deafness, ray of enfeeblement (3rd); animate dead, vampiric touch (5th); blight, death ward (7th); antilife shell, cloudkill (9th).

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.desc: Martial weapons.

features.name: Reaper
features.desc: Learn one necromancy cantrip from any list. A necromancy cantrip that targets one creature can target two within range and within 5 feet of each other.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
features.desc: When you hit with a melee attack, spend Channel Divinity for extra necrotic damage equal to 5 + twice your cleric level.

features.name: Inescapable Destruction
features.desc: Necrotic damage from your cleric spells and Channel Divinity ignores necrotic resistance.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.desc: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 necrotic (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Improved Reaper
features.desc: A 1st to 5th level necromancy spell that targets one creature can target two within range and within 5 feet of each other (consumed components needed for each).

features.name: Oath Spells
features.desc: Replaces prior oath spells: hellish rebuke, inflict wounds (3rd); crown of madness, darkness (5th); animate dead, bestow curse (9th); blight, confusion (13th); contagion, dominate person (17th). Requires evil alignment.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: Control Undead: action, an undead within 30 feet makes a Wis save or obeys you for 24 hours (no effect if its CR is at least your level). Dreadful Aspect: action, chosen creatures within 30 feet that see you make a Wis save or are frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save if they end a turn more than 30 feet away.

features.name: Aura of Hate
features.desc: You and fiends and undead within 10 feet add your Cha mod (min +1) to melee weapon damage; 30 feet at 18th. One paladin's aura per creature.

features.name: Supernatural Resistance
features.desc: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical weapons.

features.name: Dread Lord
features.desc: Action, 1 minute, once per long rest: bright light within 30 feet becomes dim; enemies frightened of you that start a turn in it take 4d10 psychic; attacks relying on sight have disadvantage against you and chosen allies in it; bonus action for a melee spell attack dealing 3d10 + Cha mod necrotic.

name: Path of the Giant
book: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

features.name: Giant's Power
features.desc: Learn Giant (or another language if you know it) and druidcraft or thaumaturgy (Wis).

features.name: Giant's Havoc
features.desc: While raging: add Rage Damage to Strength-based thrown weapon hits, reach +5 feet, and become Large if smaller and space allows.

features.name: Elemental Cleaver
features.desc: On entering rage, infuse a held weapon with acid, cold, fire, thunder or lightning: damage becomes that type, +1d6 of it, and it gains thrown (20/60) and returns after a throw. Bonus action to swap the type.

features.name: Mighty Impel
features.desc: Bonus action while raging: move a Medium or smaller creature in reach to a space within 30 feet; unwilling targets make a Str save (DC 8 + PB + Str). Unsupported targets fall prone.

features.name: Demiurgic Colossus
features.desc: Raging reach +10 feet and you can become Large or Huge; Mighty Impel works on Large or smaller; Elemental Cleaver extra damage becomes 2d6.

features.name: Guiding Whispers
features.desc: Learn guidance (not counted against cantrips known); range 60 feet for you.

features.name: Spiritual Focus
features.desc: A candle, crystal ball, skull, spirit board or tarokka deck works as your focus. From 6th, damage or healing bard spells cast through it add 1d6 to one roll.

features.name: Tales from Beyond
features.desc: Bonus action holding your focus, spend Bardic Inspiration and roll it on the Spirit Tales table; action to bestow the tale on a creature within 30 feet (or you). One tale held at a time, saves use your spell DC. Tales by roll: 1 Clever Animal (add your die to Int, Wis, Cha checks for 10 minutes), 2 Renowned Duelist (melee spell attack, two dice + Cha force), 3 Beloved Friends (target and one ally gain die + Cha temp HP), 4 Runaway (reaction teleport 30 feet, plus up to Cha mod others), 5 Avenger (1 minute, melee attackers take die force), 6 Traveler (die + bard level temp HP, +10 speed and +1 AC while they last), 7 Beguiler (Wis save or two dice psychic and incapacitated), 8 Phantom (invisible; first hit adds die necrotic and frightens), 9 Brute (Str save in 30 feet, three dice thunder and prone, half on success), 10 Dragon (30-foot cone, Dex save, four dice fire), 11 Angel (heal two dice + Cha and end blinded, deafened, paralyzed, petrified or poisoned), 12 Mind-Bender (Int save or three dice psychic and stunned).

features.name: Spirit Session
features.desc: Hour-long ritual (can be during a rest) with up to PB willing creatures: temporarily learn a divination or necromancy spell from any class of level up to the number of participants and that you can cast. Once per long rest; known until your next long rest.

features.name: Mystical Connection
features.desc: Roll twice on Spirit Tales and choose; doubles let you choose any tale.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.desc: Added to your warlock list: bane, false life (1st); blindness/deafness, phantasmal force (2nd); phantom steed, speak with dead (3rd); death ward, greater invisibility (4th); antilife shell, cloudkill (5th).

features.name: Form of Dread
features.desc: Bonus action, 1 minute, PB times per long rest: gain 1d10 + warlock level temp HP, immunity to frightened, and once per turn a hit can force a Wis save or the target is frightened until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Grave Touched
features.desc: No need to eat, drink or breathe. Once per turn change an attack's damage to necrotic; in Form of Dread roll one extra damage die.

features.name: Necrotic Husk
features.desc: Necrotic resistance (immunity in Form of Dread). Reaction when reduced to 0 HP: drop to 1 instead, chosen creatures within 30 feet take 2d10 + warlock level necrotic, and you gain a level of exhaustion. Recharges after 1d4 long rests.

features.name: Spirit Projection
features.desc: Action, once per long rest, up to 1 hour (concentration): project your spirit, leaving your body unconscious. Gain BPS resistance, no V, S or costless M components for conjuration and necromancy, fly speed equal to walking (hover, move through objects), and in Form of Dread heal half the necrotic damage you deal once per turn.

features.name: Draconic Disciple
features.desc: Draconic Presence: reaction to reroll a failed Intimidation or Persuasion check (once per long rest if it succeeds). Draconic Strike: unarmed strikes can deal acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison. Tongue of Dragons: learn Draconic or another language.

features.name: Breath of the Dragon
features.desc: Replace one attack of the Attack action with a 20-foot cone or 30-foot line: Dex save vs ki DC, two Martial Arts dice of a chosen element, half on success (three dice at 11th). PB uses per long rest, then 2 ki each.

features.name: Wings Unfurled
features.desc: When you use Step of the Wind, gain a fly speed equal to walking speed until the end of your turn. PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Aspect of the Wyrm
features.desc: Bonus action, 10-foot aura for 1 minute: Frightful Presence (bonus action, Wis save or frightened, repeating) or Resistance to a chosen element for you and allies in it. Once per long rest or 3 ki.

features.name: Ascendant Aspect
features.desc: Augment Breath: 1 ki for a 60-foot cone or 90-foot line dealing four dice. Blindsight 10 feet. Explosive Fury: activating Aspect of the Wyrm forces chosen creatures in the aura to make a Dex save or take 3d10 of a chosen element.

features.name: Draconic Gift
features.desc: Learn thaumaturgy (ranger spell) and Draconic or another language.

features.name: Drake Companion
features.desc: Action: summon your Small dragon drake within 30 feet (AC 14 + PB, HP 5 + 5 x ranger level, speed 40, bite +3 + PB for 1d6 + PB piercing, reaction Infused Strikes adds 1d6 of its essence to an ally's weapon hit within 30 feet). Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison essence for its immunity. Acts on your turn; Dodges unless you spend a bonus action to command it. Once per long rest or a 1st-level slot.

features.name: Bond of Fang and Scale
features.desc: Drake gains wings (fly speed equal to walking), grows to Medium and can be ridden (no flying while ridden), bite adds 1d6 of its essence, and you gain resistance to its essence type.

features.name: Drake's Breath
features.desc: Action: you or the drake exhale a 30-foot cone of a chosen element, Dex save vs spell DC, 8d6 (10d6 at 15th), half on success. Once per long rest or a 3rd-level slot.

features.name: Perfected Bond
features.desc: Bite adds another 1d6 (2d6 total); drake grows to Large and can fly while ridden; reaction PB times per long rest to give you or the drake resistance to one instance of damage while within 30 feet.

features.name: Manifest Echo
features.desc: Bonus action: create an echo of yourself within 15 feet (AC 14 + PB, 1 HP, immune to conditions, uses your saves); it moves 30 feet on your turn for free and is destroyed beyond 30 feet. Bonus action and 15 feet of movement to swap places; Attack action attacks can originate from it; reaction opportunity attacks from its space.

features.name: Unleash Incarnation
features.desc: When you take the Attack action, make one extra melee attack from the echo. Con mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Echo Avatar
features.desc: Action: see and hear through the echo for up to 10 minutes (you are blinded and deafened); it can be up to 1,000 feet away.

features.name: Shadow Martyr
features.desc: Reaction before an attack roll against a creature you see: teleport the echo within 5 feet of it and the attack targets the echo. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Reclaim Potential
features.desc: When your echo is destroyed by damage, gain 2d6 + Con mod temp HP if you have none. Con mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Legion of One
features.desc: Manifest two coexisting echoes; and when you roll initiative with no Unleash Incarnation uses, regain one.

features.name: Chronal Shift
features.desc: Reaction after you or a creature within 30 feet makes an attack roll, check or save: force a reroll (after seeing the result). Twice per long rest.

features.name: Temporal Awareness
features.desc: Add your Int mod to initiative.

features.name: Momentary Stasis
features.desc: Action: a Large or smaller creature within 60 feet makes a Con save or is incapacitated with speed 0 until the end of your next turn or until it takes damage. Int mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Arcane Abeyance
features.desc: When you cast a spell of 4th level or lower, store it in a bead for 1 hour (AC 15, 1 HP); a holder can release it as an action using your attack bonus and DC. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Convergent Future
features.desc: Reaction when you or a creature within 60 feet makes an attack roll, check or save: set the roll to the minimum needed to succeed or one less. Gain a level of exhaustion, removable only by a long rest.

features.name: Adjust Density
features.desc: Action, concentration up to 1 minute: halve or double the weight of a Large or smaller creature or object within 30 feet (Huge at 10th). Halved: +10 speed, double jump, disadvantage on Str checks and saves. Doubled: -10 speed, advantage on Str checks and saves.

features.name: Gravity Well
features.desc: When a spell you cast hits a creature with an attack, it fails a save, or it is willing, move it 5 feet to an unoccupied space.

features.name: Violent Attraction
features.desc: Reaction: a weapon hit by a creature within 60 feet deals an extra 1d10, or a fall within 60 feet deals an extra 2d10. Int mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Event Horizon
features.desc: Action, concentration up to 1 minute: hostile creatures starting a turn within 30 feet make a Str save, taking 2d10 force and speed 0 on a failure, or half damage and 2 extra feet per foot moved on a success. Once per long rest or a 3rd-level slot.

name: Lunar Sorcery
book: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

features.name: Lunar Embodiment
features.desc: Learn the Lunar Spells (not counted against spells known): shield, ray of sickness, color spray (1st); lesser restoration, blindness/deafness, alter self (3rd); dispel magic, vampiric touch, phantom steed (5th); death ward, confusion, hallucinatory terrain (7th); Rary's telepathic bond, hold monster, mislead (9th). After a long rest pick Full, New or Crescent Moon; cast that phase's 1st-level spell once free per long rest.

features.name: Moon Fire
features.desc: Learn sacred flame (not counted against cantrips); it can target two creatures within 5 feet of each other.

features.name: Lunar Boons
features.desc: Metamagic on spells of your phase's schools costs 1 less sorcery point (Full: abjuration, divination; New: enchantment, necromancy; Crescent: illusion, transmutation). PB times per long rest.

features.name: Waxing and Waning
features.desc: Bonus action and 1 sorcery point to change phase. You can cast each phase's 1st-level spell once free per long rest while in that phase.

features.name: Lunar Empowerment
features.desc: Full: bonus action to shed 10-foot bright light, advantage on Investigation and Perception for you and chosen creatures in it. New: advantage on Stealth, and attacks against you have disadvantage while you are in darkness. Crescent: resistance to necrotic and radiant.

features.name: Lunar Phenomenon
features.desc: Bonus action (or as part of changing phase), once per long rest each or 5 sorcery points. Full: chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Con save or are blinded until the end of their next turn, and one creature regains 3d8 HP. New: Dex save or 3d10 necrotic and speed 0, and you turn invisible until the end of your next turn. Crescent: teleport 60 feet with one willing creature, both gaining resistance to all damage until your next turn.

features.name: Martial Maneuvers
features.desc: Learn three Carrion Raven maneuvers (one more at 6th, 10th, and 14th; swap one each time). Maneuver points equal twice your Barbarian level, regained on a long rest; one maneuver per turn; save DC 8 + PB + Con mod. Apex Dominance (5, action): Str save (Disadvantage if you grapple it) or 6d10 force, half on success; kills outright at 0 HP. Axolotl's Regeneration (2 or 6, bonus action): heal 1d12 + Con mod; at 6 points also regrow a limb or organ. Bestial Transformation (8, action): polymorph yourself into a beast of CR up to half your level, keeping mental scores. Call of the Beast Lord (5, action, concentration): summon a beast of CR up to your level for 10 minutes. Carrion Feast (4, action): melee attack with +5d6 necrotic and temp HP equal to it. Falcon's Glide (1, reaction): slow a fall to 60 feet per round, and 1 more point per bonus action for 30-foot flight that turn. Feral Fighting (1, bonus action): an unarmed strike dealing 1d8. Hibernating Bear Recuperation (5, action): a 10-minute sleep with resistance to non-psychic damage that counts as a short rest, ends poison, removes 1 exhaustion, and turns spent Hit Dice into temp HP. Pack Leader (1, reaction): when an adjacent enemy is attacked, give that attack advantage and attack it yourself. Predator's Howl (2, bonus action): two creatures within 30 feet make a Wis save or are frightened until your next turn, taking +1d6 psychic from weapon hits. Shape of the Behemoth (3, action, concentration, 1 minute): grow a size (max Large), +5 feet reach, +1d6 weapon damage, 1d6 temp HP each turn. Slippery Otter (1, bonus action): swim 30, hold breath for twice your Con score in minutes, bonus action Dash in water for an hour. Snout of the Bloodhound (1, 1 minute): for an hour, advantage on Perception and tracking, add PB to initiative, no disadvantage against invisible creatures. Stoic Oxen Spirit (2, reaction): end charmed or frightened and gain advantage against its source until the end of your next turn. Trampling Bull (3, bonus action): move your speed through creatures your size or smaller; each makes a Str save or falls prone and takes 1d8 + Str mod bludgeoning. Tusks of the Rampaging Mammoth (3, action): a melee attack dealing +3d12 and pushing a Huge or smaller target 15 feet. Woolly Beast's Hide (2+, reaction): reduce a hit's damage by 1d6 per 2 points and gain that much temp HP.

features.name: Feral Celerity
features.desc: Make one weapon attack as part of the bonus action that starts your rage, and you can concentrate on maneuvers (not spells) while raging.

features.name: Raven's Spirit
features.desc: Proficiency in Animal Handling (or Athletics, Nature, or Survival if you have it), and you can cast speak with animals as a ritual.

features.name: Ferocious Rage
features.desc: When you rage, chosen creatures within 10 feet that can see you make a Wisdom save against your maneuver DC or are frightened of you until the end of their next turn.

features.name: Violent Hunger
features.desc: Once per attack, when a weapon damage die rolls its maximum, spend 1 maneuver point to roll another of that die and add it.

features.name: Chilling Melody
features.desc: Learn two necromancy cantrips from any list; they are bard spells and don't count against your cantrips known.

features.name: Pluck the Heartstrings
features.desc: A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die can spend it when dealing weapon damage to add the roll as necrotic damage, or as a reaction when a living creature drops to 0 hit points to drop to 1 instead.

features.name: Stir the Bones
features.desc: Learn animate dead (a bard spell that doesn't count against spells known). When you give out Bardic Inspiration, up to PB undead you control within 60 feet each gain a Dirge die usable like Bardic Inspiration within 10 minutes, and you can command them with the same bonus action. An undead that spends a Dirge die on a hit also adds it to damage.

features.name: Dance of the Dead
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, a single-target necromancy spell you cast can target a second creature in range at no extra component cost.

features.name: Inquisition Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at cleric levels: 1st detect magic, identify; 3rd see invisibility, silence; 5th dispel magic, remove curse; 7th arcane eye, locate creature; 9th creation, hallow.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Witch Hunter's Strike
features.desc: Wisdom modifier times (min 1) per long rest, a weapon hit deals +1d8 force (2d8 against a concentrating creature); at 14th level 2d8 and 3d8. If the target then fails its concentration save, gain temp HP equal to that extra damage.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Spell Shield
features.desc: As a bonus action, a creature within 30 feet (or you) gains 1d10 + cleric level temp HP for up to 1 hour; while they last it has resistance to spell damage and advantage on saves against spells.

features.name: Rebuke Invoker
features.desc: Wisdom modifier times (min 1) per long rest, as a reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell: Constitution save or 1d8 per slot level (cantrips count as 1st) + Wis mod force, half on success.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.desc: Once per turn a weapon hit deals +1d8 force (2d8 at 14th level).

features.name: Supernal Safeguard
features.desc: Spell Shield can target up to your Wisdom modifier (min 2) creatures.

features.name: Martial Maneuvers
features.desc: Learn three Blade Breaker maneuvers (more at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th; swap one each time). Maneuver points equal twice your fighter level, regained on a long rest; one maneuver per turn; save DC 8 + PB + Str or Dex mod. Arcing Iron (1+, bonus action): your next melee attack also hits each other creature in reach, 1 point per extra target. Armor-Crushing Blows (4): a hit deals no damage but a Dex or Con save or nonmagical armor loses 2 AC (destroyed if already damaged). Blade Breaking Blow (4): the same against a nonmagical weapon (half damage, then destroyed). Blade of Eternal Demise (3, action): for 8 hours your weapon's damage to a named creature also lowers its HP maximum until a long rest, and it can't be revived while the weapon touches it. Commanding Grasp (2, action): a creature your size or smaller within 30 feet makes a Str save or is teleported next to you and grappled. Contest of Wills (1, bonus action): opposed Intimidation; the winner has advantage on attacks against the other until the end of its next turn. Disarming Swipe (2): a hit deals no damage but a Str or Dex save or it drops its weapons and shield. Helmsplitter (4): on a hit, Con save or stunned until the end of its next turn (disadvantage if you had advantage). Iron Tempest (4, action): your hits this turn deal +2d6 and you make PB extra attacks, each at a different target. Refusal to Bleed (1, reaction): reduce damage by 1d10 + fighter level; 3 more points extends it to that attacker until your next turn. Steely Determination (1): Second Wind heals an extra fighter level. Unstoppable Missile (2, action): throw your melee weapon in a 30-foot line; Dex save or weapon damage + Str or Dex mod, 1 point more per creature for +2d6. Wall of Blades (2, reaction): when hit, attack the attacker and use the attack roll as your AC until your next turn.

features.name: Stance of the Blade Breaker
features.desc: Learn a stance (more at 7th, 10th, and 15th); enter one on initiative and switch as a bonus action. Adamantine Bull: reaction to push a same-size-or-smaller melee attacker 5 feet on a failed Str save (10 feet at 18th). Iron Punisher: advantage on your melee attacks but attacks against you have advantage (+2d6 damage at 18th). Steel Serpent: +5 feet reach on your turn (always at 18th). Weightless Mithral: advantage on Dex saves (bonus action Dodge at 18th).

features.name: Unyielding Determination
features.desc: Advantage on saving throws made during your turn.

features.name: Breaker of Minds
features.desc: As a bonus action, spend up to 3 maneuver points to deal 1d6 psychic per point to a creature you are grappling.

features.name: Adrenaline Rush
features.desc: Second Wind also restores maneuver points equal to half your fighter level.

features.name: Blooded Clarity
features.desc: Below half your hit points, add a d10 to the first attack roll or save you make each turn, and maneuvers cost 1 point less (min 1).

features.name: Oath Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at paladin levels: 3rd detect evil and good, hunter's mark; 5th detect thoughts, knock; 9th fear, tongues; 13th divination, locate creature; 17th insect plague, scrying.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: Mark of the Heretic: as a bonus action mark a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute; your weapon attacks against it crit on 19-20 and you can use your reaction to attack it whenever its turn starts. Inquisitor's Eye: as a bonus action gain advantage on Investigation, Insight, and Perception for 10 minutes and you can't be surprised.

features.name: Aura of Clarity
features.desc: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet can't be blinded while you are conscious, and chosen creatures and objects in range gain nothing from being invisible. 30 feet at 18th level.

features.name: Compel Confession
features.desc: Cast zone of truth without a slot; creatures that pass the save take 1d4 psychic at the start of each of their turns in the area.

features.name: Apocalyptic Revelation
features.desc: Once per long rest, as an action for 1 minute: truesight 120 feet; creatures that start their turn or move within 5 feet of you make a Con save or are blinded until their next turn; and as a bonus action pick a creature within 60 feet that all attacks hit with advantage until your next turn.

features.name: Evil Eye
features.desc: As a bonus action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Cha save against your misfortune DC (8 + PB + Cha mod) or is marked for 1 minute (one at a time). You can Sneak Attack it without advantage, provided you don't have disadvantage.

features.name: Misfortunist
features.desc: Learn two misfortunes (one more at 9th, 13th, and 17th; swap one per long rest). You have 4 jinx points (6 at 13th), regained on a short or long rest. Befuddled (2, action): charmed 10 minutes. Clumsy (3, reaction when it moves 5 feet): prone and speed 0. Debilitated (1, reaction when it takes damage): +1d12 necrotic. Doomed (1, reaction after a miss): make another weapon attack. Fearful (2, action): frightened 1 minute (Wis save each turn). Inept (1, reaction): it rerolls a check or attack and keeps the lower. Insensate (3, action): blinded and deafened 1 minute (Con save each turn). Maimed (2, reaction): a hit on 18-19 becomes a crit. Marked (2, bonus action): the mark lasts 24 hours and you sense its direction. Plagued (1, reaction): halve its healing and block healing until your next turn. Ruined (2, reaction): it rerolls a save and keeps the lower. Somnolent (3, action): roll d10s equal to your rogue level + 15; if that meets its current HP it falls unconscious for 10 minutes. Unlucky (3, bonus action): subtract 1d4 from its attacks and saves while marked.

features.name: Steal Luck
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, as a reaction remove advantage from a roll by a creature within 30 feet and regain a jinx point.

features.name: Curse Caster
features.desc: Spend 3 jinx points and an action to cast bestow curse (Charisma).

features.name: Improved Steal Luck
features.desc: Steal Luck works three times per short or long rest.

features.name: Hellfire Claw
features.desc: While raging one hand becomes a fiery claw: your first weapon hit each turn with that hand's weapon deals +1d6 fire, or if you dealt no such fire damage, a bonus action unarmed strike with the empty claw (bludgeoning or slashing) adds 1d6 fire. The fire die grows to 1d8 at 6th level, 1d10 at 10th, 1d12 at 14th.

features.name: Hellborn
features.desc: Learn Abyssal or Infernal, and add Str mod to Intimidation and Persuasion checks with fiends (Intimidation with anyone from 10th level).

features.name: Infernal Warrior
features.desc: Resistance to fire damage. While raging, a successful grapple from the Attack action deals your claw's fire damage, and again at the end of each of the target's turns while grappled.

features.name: Planar Conspirator
features.desc: As an action spend 2 Hit Dice (without healing) to cast detect thoughts (DC 8 + PB + Con mod).

features.name: Incinerating Wrath
features.desc: Twice per rage, when a creature you can see within 60 feet damages you, use your reaction for a 3rd-level hellish rebuke (DC 8 + PB + Con mod).

features.name: Coin Flip
features.desc: A creature using your Bardic Inspiration can flip a coin instead of rolling: heads it counts as the maximum; tails the GM keeps the die to boost a creature of their choice later (lost on your long rest).

features.name: Magic Coin
features.desc: Any coin is your spellcasting focus. As an action fling a coin within 60 feet (ranged spell attack using Charisma): 1 bludgeoning + 1d12 thunder (2d12 at 6th, 3d12 at 14th), then it returns; a natural 20 against a hostile creature with a real coin duplicates it.

features.name: Money Talks
features.desc: Cha mod times (min 1) per long rest, as an action enchant a held coin for 10 minutes: whoever holds it and you understand each other's speech, and you have advantage on your first Persuasion check haggling with them; or as an action see and hear through it until your next turn.

features.name: Shrewd Consumer
features.desc: Consumed material components, potions, and scrolls worth up to 500 gp have a 50 percent chance not to be used up, and you can Use an Object or drink a potion as a bonus action.

features.name: Festus Domain Spells
features.desc: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st goodberry, purify food and drink; 3rd heat metal, protection from poison; 5th create food and water, stinking cloud; 7th blight, control water; 9th cloudkill, contagion.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Heavy armor, martial weapons, brewer's supplies, and cook's utensils.

features.name: Table-Turner
features.desc: Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, when a creature within 5 feet hits you, use your reaction: Con save or 1d12 poison and poisoned until the end of its next turn, or half damage only.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Create Healing Draft
features.desc: As an action create a potion; a creature that drinks it as a bonus action heals 2d6 + cleric level. It crumbles on your next short or long rest.

features.name: Strong Stomach
features.desc: Advantage on saves against poison and resistance to acid and poison damage. Your create food and water is delicious and can include up to 5 gallons of ale or wine. Once per long rest, as an action suppress being drunk or poisoned for 1 minute.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.desc: Once per turn a weapon hit deals +1d8 acid or poison (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Invigorating Feast
features.desc: Once per long rest, bless a meal for you and up to six others: after 10 minutes of eating, each gains 2d6 + 10 temp HP and immunity to being charmed or magically slept for 8 hours.

features.name: Draconic Lore
features.desc: Learn Draconic, and add PB (double if proficient) to History checks about dragons.

features.name: Dragon Shape
features.desc: As a bonus action spend a Wild Shape use to become a Medium dragon of a chosen color for up to half your druid level in hours, keeping your statistics: AC 13 + Dex mod (max 2), walk and climb 30, temp HP equal to your HP maximum. No spellcasting, but your bite is an unarmed strike using Wis for 1d12 + Str or Wis mod piercing, and a breath weapon (action, once per minute) deals 2d6 of your color's type in a 15-foot cone (Dex save, half on success), growing to 3d6/20 feet at 6th, 4d6/25 feet at 10th, 5d6/30 feet at 14th.

features.name: Improved Dragon Shape
features.desc: In dragon shape: AC 14 + Dex (max 2), claws (2d6 + Str or Wis slashing) so the Attack action gives a bite and a claw, attacks count as magical, and darkvision 60 feet (or +30).

features.name: Draconic Magic
features.desc: In dragon shape you can cast druid spells of 3rd level or lower without material components; AC 15 + Dex (max 2), resistance to your color's damage type, fly 30.

features.name: Heart of a Dragon
features.desc: Once per long rest use the breath weapon outside dragon shape. In dragon shape: AC 16 + Dex (max 2), fly 40, three attacks (bite and two claws), and you can be Large with a 10-foot bite reach.

features.name: Launch
features.desc: Three times per short or long rest (four at 7th, five at 15th), as a bonus action leap up to 15 feet in any combination of directions (30 at 7th) without provoking, reducing any fall after by 30 feet. A melee attack right after or during the leap has advantage and deals +1d8 (1d10 at 10th, 1d12 at 18th).

features.name: Nimble Lancer
features.desc: Unmounted, a lance is versatile for you (1d8 one hand, 1d12 two; Launch attacks count as two-handed). After hitting an adjacent creature with a lance, step 5 feet away without provoking it.

features.name: Bird Caller
features.desc: Advantage on Animal Handling with flying beasts, and cast animal messenger as a ritual on flying beasts.

features.name: Steel Grace
features.desc: Armor never gives you Stealth disadvantage. When you make a Dex save you can Launch as a reaction, taking no damage on a success and half on a failure.

features.name: Eagle Eye
features.desc: Your Launch attack crits on 19-20, and a flier it hits makes a Str save (DC 8 + PB + Str mod) or has speed 0 until its next turn. Perception proficiency, doubled for sight.

features.name: Predatory Instinct
features.desc: Advantage on initiative, and regain a Launch use if you have none when you roll it.

features.name: Improved Launch
features.desc: Launch attack hits knock the target prone on a failed Str save. Once per short or long rest you can leap up to 90 feet with no falling damage until you land, at the cost of a level of exhaustion (not usable at two or more levels).

features.name: Spirit Strike
features.desc: Any unarmed strike can instead be a proficient melee spell attack with 30-foot reach using Wis for attack and damage, dealing your Martial Arts die of force. From 6th level it can deliver Stunning Strike.

features.name: Spirit Hand
features.desc: Learn mage hand with no verbal or somatic components, cast and controlled as a bonus action.

features.name: Spectral Guide
features.desc: You can't be possessed by ghosts or similar undead; spend 2 ki as an action to cast gentle repose or see invisibility without material components; learn spare the dying. Dismiss Undead: a Flurry of Blows hit forces an undead of low enough CR (1/2 at 6th, 1 at 8th, 2 at 11th, 3 at 14th, 4 at 17th) to make a Wis save against your ki DC or be put to rest.

features.name: Ghost Walker
features.desc: Etherstep: 1 ki as a bonus action (or 1 extra ki with Step of the Wind, which also lets you pass through creatures and thin objects) makes you invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack or cast. Phase: Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, a reaction reduces a hit's damage by your monk level.

features.name: Sight Beyond Sight
features.desc: Truesight and telepathy 60 feet, and once per long rest cast etherealness lasting 1 minute.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.desc: Oath spells at paladin levels: 3rd bane, detect magic; 5th arcanist's magic aura, hold person; 9th dispel magic, slow; 13th dimension door, resilient sphere; 17th dominate person, scrying.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: Absorb Magic: as a reaction stop a spell being cast within 30 feet if its level is no higher than 1 + a third of your paladin level (round up, max 6th), gaining Cha mod + 5 x its level temp HP. Expeditious Command: as a bonus action up to Cha mod creatures within 30 feet can Dash or Disengage as a bonus action until your next turn, and you take one of those actions now.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.desc: Proficiency in Arcana.

features.name: Aura of Disruption
features.desc: A hostile creature that ends its turn within 10 feet while concentrating makes a Con save against your spell DC or loses concentration. You and allies within 10 feet can't be perceived by scrying sensors. 30 feet at 18th level.

features.name: Armored Focus
features.desc: Damage can't break your concentration on paladin spells.

features.name: Arcane Conduit
features.desc: Once per long rest, as an action for 1 minute in a 30-foot radius: resistance to spell damage and advantage on saves against spells, melee attackers take force equal to Cha mod, and whenever you spend a spell slot allies in the field heal and enemies take force equal to Cha mod.

features.name: Rocborne Magic
features.desc: Bonus ranger spells known at ranger levels: 3rd feather fall, 5th gust of wind, 9th lightning bolt, 13th ice storm, 17th legend lore.

features.name: Guiding Wind
features.desc: Once per turn either add 1d4 of the weapon's type to a weapon hit (1d8 at 11th), or redirect a miss to another target within 5 feet (15 at 11th) and in range, using the original roll + Wis mod.

features.name: Whispers of Knowledge
features.desc: Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, 10 minutes of meditation grants a skill or tool proficiency until your next use or rest.

features.name: Windswept
features.desc: +5 feet walking speed, unaffected by strong wind, resistance to cold damage, and acclimated to high altitude.

features.name: Soar
features.desc: Right after a running jump, a bonus action grows spectral wings until your next turn ends or you land, giving you a flying speed equal to your walking speed.

features.name: Hurricane
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, when you take damage use your reaction for resistance (or ignore falling damage); creatures you choose within 15 feet make a Str save or take bludgeoning equal to your ranger level and fall prone (half and not prone on success), and the wind can carry you 30 feet without provoking.

features.name: Medic
features.desc: Medicine proficiency with double PB. As a bonus action stabilize an unconscious creature within 5 feet, or spend a healer's kit use to heal 1d4 + PB (once per creature per short or long rest).

features.name: Transfusion
features.desc: Once per turn when your Sneak Attack damages a creature that isn't a construct or undead, gain Wis mod (min 1) temp HP until your next turn (twice that at 13th).

features.name: Field Surgeon
features.desc: At the start of a short rest pick a willing creature in reach; at its end it heals your Sneak Attack dice total (once per long rest per creature).

features.name: Toxic Shock
features.desc: When Transfusion triggers, the target loses 10 feet of speed and has disadvantage on its next attack or check before the end of its next turn.

features.name: Bloodbound
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, after your Sneak Attack damages a beast or humanoid, it makes a Con save (DC 8 + PB + Wis mod) or falls under dominate beast or dominate person for 1 minute.

features.name: Dunetreader
features.desc: Sand difficult terrain doesn't slow you, and you tolerate heat up to 150 degrees Fahrenheit unprotected.

features.name: Sandstorm
features.desc: When you cast a 1st-level or higher spell on your turn, a bonus action raises a 5-foot twister within 30 feet: a Large or smaller creature there makes a Str save or is pushed 10 feet (5 if Large). From 6th level it also takes 1d8 bludgeoning or fire (2d8 at 14th, 3d8 at 18th).

features.name: Mirage
features.desc: Learn mirror image (or another sorcerer spell if known), not counted against spells known; cast it with 2 sorcery points or a slot. Cast with sorcery points, each destroyed duplicate deals fire equal to half your sorcerer level to creatures within 10 feet.

features.name: Desert Nomad
features.desc: Right after Sandstorm pushes a creature (or lands in an empty space), spend 2 sorcery points to teleport into the twister's space, invisible until the end of your turn.

features.name: Sand Form
features.desc: As a bonus action spend 5 sorcery points for 1 minute: you can't be grappled, slip through 1-inch gaps, move through any creature, and ignore difficult terrain. When hit, a reaction gives you resistance to all damage until the end of that turn.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.desc: Added to your warlock list: 1st entangle, magic missile; 2nd scorching ray, see invisibility; 3rd blink, nondetection; 4th arcane eye, black tentacles; 5th mislead, telepathic bond.

features.name: Eldritch Heads
features.desc: You have PB invisible spectral heads, refreshed on a long rest (and once per long rest restore two as a bonus action). Expend one to: deal 1 + PB psychic on a hit (once per turn); gain advantage on Intimidation; or turn a failed death save into a success.

features.name: Guarded
features.desc: While you have a head left, you can't be surprised and allies' adjacency doesn't give attackers advantage against you.

features.name: Improved Eldritch Heads
features.desc: Also expend a head to: gain 2d6 + Cha mod temp HP as a bonus action; take a second reaction in a round (not on the turn you used your normal one); or reroll a failed save against being charmed, frightened, or magically slept.

features.name: Groupthink
features.desc: Add half your PB to Intelligence checks, Perception checks, and Intelligence saves.

features.name: Eldritch Frenzy
features.desc: Once per long rest, as an action regain all heads with a roar; up to that many creatures within 60 feet make an Int save or take 4d8 psychic and are incapacitated until the end of your next turn (half and not incapacitated on success).

features.name: Core Wand
features.desc: Craft a personal wand that is your focus and can be summoned to your hand as a bonus action from anywhere (8 hours to remake). It holds up to 7 core charges, resetting to 1 on a long rest, and gains half a spell's level (min 1) whenever you cast a leveled spell with it. Spend charges to add that many to an attack roll or save (after rolling, before the result), or as a reaction to add that many to AC against a hit.

features.name: Wand Savant
features.desc: Copy wizard spells from staves and wands you hold into your spellbook as from scrolls. Touch-range wizard spells cast with your core wand can target a visible creature not behind cover up to 10 feet away (30 at 14th).

features.name: Arcane Battery
features.desc: Arcane Recovery also restores 3 core charges. Spend up to 3 charges to raise the save DC of a single-target saving throw spell by that much.

features.name: Imbue Minor Wand
features.desc: On each long rest imbue up to Int mod (min 1) wizard spells (non-damaging cantrips or 1st-2nd level, action or bonus action, no concentration or costly components) into a stick that anyone can use with an action; it has Int mod charges (cantrip 0, 1st 1, 2nd 2) and uses your DC and attack bonus until your next long rest.

features.name: Manifest Charges
features.desc: Bonus action: spend charges to fire that many force motes at different targets within 60 feet for 1d4 + Int mod each. Reaction: spend charges to reduce damage to you or a creature within 30 feet by three per charge. You never roll for a staff or wand's last charge, and crafting magic wands costs half the time and gold.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.desc: As a bonus action spend a Wild Shape use to become smoky shadow for 10 minutes, keeping your statistics: Hide as a bonus action in dim light or darkness, squeeze through 1-inch gaps, and a reaction deals cold damage equal to PB to a creature you see hit you in melee.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at druid levels: 2nd bane, false life; 3rd darkness, darkvision; 5th blink, fear; 7th black tentacles, greater invisibility; 9th cone of cold, dream.

features.name: Dark Servant
features.desc: Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, as a bonus action animate the shadow of a creature within 30 feet (shadow stat block) for up to 5 minutes: it acts on your initiative, moves to and attacks only that creature, and its hits deal no damage but give disadvantage on the target's next attack or save before the shadow's next turn.

features.name: Shadow Mass
features.desc: In Umbral Form you also fly at your speed and hover, and resist nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.

features.name: Darkness Falls
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, as an action emit a moving 15-foot sphere of magical darkness for 1 minute that darkvision can't pierce (except creatures you choose); it dispels overlapping light spells of 7th level or lower and ends in sunlight.

features.name: Dancing Shadows
features.desc: As a bonus action spend a Bardic Inspiration for a 20-foot sphere of shadows around you for 1 minute: allies inside have half cover and outsiders have disadvantage on Perception into it (darkvision doesn't help). Dispels overlapping light spells of 2nd level or lower.

features.name: Fear of the Dark
features.desc: In dim light or darkness, you and allies who can see you have advantage against fear effects, and hostile creatures who can see you have disadvantage against them.

features.name: Shade Step
features.desc: Right after a creature adds your Bardic Inspiration to a roll, it can teleport up to 30 feet without provoking.

features.name: Night Music
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, when you cast a spell, use your reaction so up to Cha mod creatures within 60 feet who saw and heard it make a Cha save or are frightened for 1 minute (repeat save each turn).

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st command, hunter's mark; 3rd calm emotions, warding bond; 5th beacon of hope, spirit guardians; 7th death ward, guardian of faith; 9th hallow, telepathic bond.

features.name: Blessed Chosen
features.desc: Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, use your reaction to give disadvantage to an enemy's attack on an ally within 30 feet.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Martial weapons and the Persuasion skill.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Divine Initiative
features.desc: As an action, up to Wis mod creatures within 60 feet that can see you gain 5 temp HP (8 at 6th, 11 at 8th, 14 at 17th) and can each use their reaction to make one weapon attack.

features.name: Fighting Fit
features.desc: Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, as a reaction end charmed, frightened, paralyzed, or stunned on yourself or an ally within 30 feet.

features.name: Hobbling Strike
features.desc: Once per turn a weapon hit forces a Str save against your spell DC or the target is knocked prone (and from 14th level its speed is halved until your next turn).

features.name: Duty Over Death
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, when an ally within 60 feet drops to 0 hit points but isn't killed, it stays conscious and regains half its hit point maximum.

features.name: Trick of the Light
features.desc: See normally in magical and nonmagical darkness out to 60 feet.

features.name: Flickering Aura
features.desc: Choose light-shifted or dark-shifted each long rest. As an action emit a 15-foot aura of bright light (or nonmagical darkness), resizable by 5 feet as a bonus action between 10 and 30 feet.

features.name: Refraction Shield
features.desc: As a bonus action spend 3 sorcery points for a 10-minute shield: melee attackers within 5 feet that hit you take 2d8 radiant (light-shifted) or necrotic (dark-shifted).

features.name: Aura Magnification
features.desc: Your aura becomes sunlight (light) or magical darkness (dark), dispelling overlapping light or darkness spells up to your highest slot level.

features.name: Spell Blind
features.desc: As an action spend 5 sorcery points: for 1 minute (concentration), hostile creatures starting their turn within 60 feet make a Con save or are blinded until the aura ends.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.desc: Added to your warlock list: 1st detect poison and disease, inflict wounds; 2nd ray of enfeeblement, silence; 3rd stinking cloud, vampiric touch; 4th greater invisibility, phantasmal killer; 5th cloudkill, contagion.

features.name: Poison Soul
features.desc: Your poison damage ignores resistance and immunity.

features.name: Venomous Mark
features.desc: As a bonus action curse a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute: your spell attack hits on it deal +1d6 poison (once per spell). If it drops to 0, a later bonus action moves the curse. One target at a time.

features.name: Sickening Revenge
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, when you take damage, use your reaction: the attacker makes a Con save or is poisoned for 1 minute (repeat save each turn).

features.name: Dark Inoculation
features.desc: Immune to disease, poison damage, and the poisoned condition.

features.name: Touch of Sorrow
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, when you hit with an attack the target makes a Wis save or is paralyzed and poisoned for 24 hours; the paralysis ends if it takes damage or stops being poisoned.

features.name: Shadow Symbiote
features.desc: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60) and sight through magical darkness to 30 feet, but sunlight sensitivity (disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception in sunlight).

features.name: Dark Transfusion
features.desc: As a bonus action spend two spell slots to recover one slot of a level no higher than their combined levels.

features.name: Orb of Night
features.desc: When attacked, use your reaction (before knowing the result) to wrap yourself in a 10-foot sphere of magical darkness until your next turn. If that attacker still hits, you can't use this against it again until a long rest.

features.name: From the Shadows
features.desc: When you roll initiative in dim light or darkness, you are hidden from creatures at least 10 feet away until you move, attack, or cast.

features.name: Second Skin
features.desc: In dim light or darkness, +2 AC and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st bane, false life; 3rd blindness/deafness, darkness; 5th blink, fear; 7th black tentacles, greater invisibility; 9th cone of cold, dream.

features.name: Cover of Night
features.desc: Stealth proficiency, darkvision 60 feet (or +30), and Hide as a bonus action in dim light or darkness.

features.name: Lengthen Shadow
features.desc: Your shadow can deliver your touch cleric spells to a creature you see within 15 feet (30 at 10th level).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Shadow Grasp
features.desc: As an action a creature within 30 feet makes a Str save: restrained by its shadow until the end of your next turn on a failure, grappled on a success.

features.name: Fade to Black
features.desc: PB times per long rest, as a bonus action in dim light or darkness turn invisible for 1 minute (ends if you attack or cast).

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.desc: Add Wis mod to the damage of your cleric cantrips.

features.name: Army of Shadow
features.desc: Shadow Grasp can target up to PB creatures.

features.name: Shadow Smoke
features.desc: While raging, smoke fills 10 feet around you; other creatures starting their turn in it have disadvantage on their next attack roll.

features.name: Creeping Fog
features.desc: As an action teleport up to 60 feet to a space you can see, making one melee attack before or after.

features.name: Consume Darkness
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, while raging in dim light or darkness, a bonus action heals 1d12 + Con mod, and you regain 1 HP at the start of each turn for the rest of the rage.

features.name: Corrosive Haze
features.desc: Hostile creatures entering or starting their turn in your Shadow Smoke make a Con save (DC 8 + PB + Con mod) or are blinded until their next turn.

features.name: Eyes in the Dark
features.desc: Darkvision 120 feet.

features.name: Shadow Bind
features.desc: After an hour's meditation in darkness during a long rest, pick one boon for 24 hours: teleport up to half your speed between dim or dark spaces as part of your move with advantage on your next Stealth check; or gain half cover after moving at least half your speed in dim light or darkness; or once per turn add PB cold damage to a weapon hit.

features.name: Cloaked Dagger
features.desc: You can Sneak Attack without advantage against a creature within 30 feet while you're in dim light or darkness, if you lack disadvantage.

features.name: Black Magic
features.desc: Three times per long rest cast darkness as a bonus action without material components. As an action in dim light or darkness become invisible until you attack, cast, or enter bright light.

features.name: Shadow Grasp
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, when you deal Sneak Attack damage, the target makes a Dex save (DC 8 + PB + Dex mod) or is restrained for 1 minute (repeat save each turn).

features.name: Wise Words
features.desc: Proficiency in Performance and Persuasion, and use Wis instead of Cha for Charisma-based skill checks.

features.name: Charming Aura
features.desc: As an action spend 1 ki to cast charm person or command, or 2 ki for suggestion.

features.name: Righteous Strike
features.desc: Once per turn spend 1 ki when an unarmed strike hits to add radiant (good or neutral) or necrotic (evil) damage equal to PB.

features.name: Blessed Chosen
features.desc: Once per long rest, when you drop to 0 hit points you immediately regain HP equal to your monk level, or instead as an action revive a creature dead up to 10 minutes with HP equal to your monk level.

features.name: Force of Personality
features.desc: When a creature first tries to attack you on a turn, use your reaction for a Performance or Persuasion check; if it beats the creature's Wisdom score, it must pick another target or waste the attack.

name: College of Fleshweaving
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

features.name: Malleable Visage
features.desc: Proficiency with surgeon's tools, which can be your spellcasting focus. You know alter self (a bard spell for you, not counted against spells known) and can cast it over 1 minute without a slot, Change Appearance only and without concentration. Once per long rest, 10 minutes with surgeon's tools gives a willing creature the Change Appearance effect until it finishes a long rest.

features.name: Suturer
features.desc: You know spiritual weapon (a bard spell for you, not counted against spells known) and can cast it once per long rest without a slot; as a bard spell it is a giant needle and thread dealing piercing damage. Suture (3rd): as an action or bonus action, spend a Bardic Inspiration to move the weapon 20 feet and give a creature within 5 feet of it temporary hit points equal to one Bardic Inspiration roll, or stabilize it at 0. Unspool (5th): as an action, spend a Bardic Inspiration to move it 20 feet; a creature within 5 feet makes a Strength save or is restrained for 1 minute (action to repeat the save). Acupuncture (10th): as an action, spend a Bardic Inspiration to move it 20 feet and make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet: piercing equal to a Bardic Inspiration roll + Charisma modifier, and a Constitution save or paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Ritual Reskin
features.desc: Over 10 minutes, give up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) creatures within 60 feet, including you, one shared adaptation for 1 hour. Bull's Buns: advantage on Strength checks and one size larger for carrying and lifting. Cactus Skin: grapplers make a Constitution save at the end of the target's turn or take piercing equal to your Bardic Inspiration die and release it (half and no release on a success). Cat's Paws: advantage on Dexterity checks and no damage from falls of 20 feet or less. Fish Form: breathe water and swim speed equal to walking speed. Owl's Sight: advantage on Wisdom checks and initiative. Rhino's Hide: advantage on Constitution checks and temporary hit points equal to a Bardic Inspiration roll + Charisma modifier. Once per long rest, or again by expending a 3rd-level or higher slot.

features.name: Soulsew
features.desc: A creature that uses one of your Bardic Inspiration dice, or fails a save against Unspool or Acupuncture, is soulsewn to you for 1 minute by a thread visible only to you and truesight (it breaks beyond 100 feet). Spool: as a bonus action, teleport to the nearest unoccupied space to a soulsewn creature, or swap places with it (an unwilling creature contests with Charisma; you lose if there isn't room). Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.

name: Circle of the Hive
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

features.name: Circle Spells
features.desc: You learn the swarm cantrip. Always prepared at druid levels: 3rd blur, web; 5th fly, hypnotic pattern; 7th arcane eye, giant insect; 9th insect plague, mislead. They manifest as arthropods.

features.name: Swarm Shape
features.desc: When you use Wild Shape you can become a swarm of creatures, within the normal CR and speed limits.

features.name: Symbiotic Biosphere
features.desc: As a bonus action, rile your symbiotes for 1 minute. When a creature within 15 feet targets you with a melee attack on its turn, the swarm retaliates: Constitution save, 2d6 poison or half on a success (3d6 at 6th, 4d6 at 10th, 5d6 at 14th); once per round, until the start of your next turn. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per long rest. You can also convey basic emotions and ideas to arthropods with pheromones.

features.name: Protect the Monarch
features.desc: While Symbiotic Biosphere is active, when you take damage from a source you can see, use your reaction to reduce it by your Wisdom modifier + half your druid level (applied before resistance).

features.name: Honeydrenaline
features.desc: As a bonus action, a willing creature you can see within 30 feet regains hit points equal to your druid level and can use its reaction to move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.

features.name: Swarmsense
features.desc: Blindsight and tremorsense 10 feet, resistance to poison damage, immunity to the poisoned condition, advantage on concentration saves, and advantage on initiative.

name: Oath of the Harvest
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

features.name: Tenets of the Harvest
features.desc: Share Your Meal, Nurture Over Cure, Permit Prosperity.

features.name: Oath Tools
features.desc: Proficiency with cook's utensils.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.desc: Oath spells at paladin levels: 3rd heroism, purify food and drink; 5th prayer of healing, warding bond; 9th beacon of hope, create food and water; 13th death ward, resilient sphere; 17th greater restoration, mass cure wounds.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: Vow of Sustenance: as a bonus action, ward a creature you can see within 60 feet; it gains temporary hit points equal to twice your Charisma modifier (minimum 2) now and at the start of each of its turns for 1 minute. Share Vitality: as a bonus action, take any amount of unreducible necrotic damage up to your current hit points; up to four creatures you can see within 30 feet regain hit points equal to half of it.

features.name: Aura of Rejuvenation
features.desc: Creatures of your choice within 10 feet that regain hit points from a spell, potion, magical effect, or food regain an extra 1d6. A creature spending most of a short rest within 10 feet regains 1 extra hit point per Hit Die spent. Lay on Hands doesn't trigger it. The aura grows to 30 feet at 18th level.

features.name: Host of Heroes
features.desc: Over an hour (can be a short rest), with 25 gp of rare spices and 25 gp of diamond dust, augment a meal for you and up to nine others. For 8 hours each diner has advantage on Constitution saves, resistance to poison damage, immunity to being frightened, and 2d10 temporary hit points. Once per long rest.

features.name: Avatar of Nourishment
features.desc: As a bonus action, for 1 minute: at the start of each of your turns, creatures of your choice within 30 feet (including you) regain hit points and gain temporary hit points each equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1); you can cast revivify as a bonus action without preparing it or using a slot (components still needed); and you can use your reaction to give a creature within 30 feet resistance to damage it takes. Once per long rest, or again by expending a 5th-level slot.

name: School of Biomancy
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

features.name: Biomancy Savant
features.desc: Copying biomancy spells into your spellbook costs half the gold and time. Proficiency with surgeon's tools. These count as biomancy spells for you: false life, longstrider, alter self, darkvision, spider climb, haste, water breathing, stoneskin, flesh to stone, simulacrum, and shapechange (plus the book's biomancy spells).

features.name: Biostimulation
features.desc: When you use a slot to cast a biomancy spell of 1st level or higher, you or the target (your choice) regains hit points equal to twice the spell's level.

features.name: Self Improvement
