features.desc: Over 1 hour (can be during a rest), give yourself one improvement: Amphibisprings (jump distance tripled); Extra Appendage (tail or arm, hold one more thing, advantage on climbing checks); Detachable Hand (action: it acts as unseen servant, visible); Firefly Skin (light on yourself at will; bonus action flash forces creatures within 5 feet to make a Constitution save or be blinded until the end of your next turn, once per short rest); Owl Eyes (darkvision 120 feet); Slime (checks to grapple you have disadvantage); Scales (+1 AC without armor); Spidersense (+1d4 initiative); Talon (unarmed strikes deal 1d8 + Strength slashing, bonus action automatic damage to a creature you grapple); Third Leg (+10 feet speed, advantage against being knocked prone); Trimorphism (enlarge/reduce on yourself at will, no components or concentration). You sustain one at a time, two at 10th level, and three at 14th.

features.name: Spell Splitter
features.desc: When you cast a wizard spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, you can also target yourself. Uses equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.

features.name: Endocrine Overload
features.desc: Over 1 hour, implant a Brutish or Swift capsule; crack it as a bonus action for 1 minute of benefits. Brutish: become Large, Strength rises to your Intelligence, advantage on Strength and Constitution checks and saves, a 2d10 natural weapon (Strength-based), two attacks per Attack action, and temporary hit points equal to twice your Intelligence modifier at the start of each turn. Swift: Dexterity rises to your Intelligence, advantage on Dexterity checks and saves, 1-action cantrips can be cast as a bonus action, and the benefits of haste (can't be dispelled). Afterward you gain a level of exhaustion and can't move or act until the end of your next turn. You must craft a new capsule to use it again.

name: College of Cuisine
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

features.name: Culinary Exploration
features.desc: Proficiency with cook's utensils, which can be your spellcasting focus; double proficiency bonus on checks using them to prepare food. When you cook a dish you can add one extra ingredient, gaining its benefit on a successful Cooking check.

features.name: Petit Fours
features.desc: During a short or long rest, make treats equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) of one flavor; they stay magical until your next rest. Eating one (action or bonus action) grants a benefit until the end of the eater's next turn. Bitter: resistance to poison and advantage against being poisoned. Salty: advantage on Wisdom saves and immunity to being charmed. Sour: weapon attacks deal extra acid equal to a Bardic Inspiration roll. Sweet: temporary hit points equal to a Bardic Inspiration roll + Charisma modifier for 1 hour. Umami: +2 AC. As a bonus action, spend a Bardic Inspiration to teleport any number of your treats to creatures you can see within 60 feet; each can eat one with its reaction or as a bonus action on its next turn.

features.name: Culinary Specialisation
features.desc: Choose one. Slow Cooking: proficiency with medium and heavy armor, shields, and martial weapons, and temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus at the start of each turn. Fast Food: proficiency with medium armor and Extra Attack. Patissier: learn two spells of any list (cantrips or levels you can cast), not counted against spells known; once per long rest when you finish a short rest, spend a Bardic Inspiration and recover spell slots totaling up to the roll (none 6th level or higher).

features.name: Executive Chef
features.desc: When a creature that can hear you rolls one of your Bardic Inspiration dice or eats one of your Petit Fours, it can immediately use its reaction to make one weapon attack or move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks (eating a Petit Four can be part of that same action).

name: Hunt Domain
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st entangle, longstrider; 3rd locate animals or plants, pass without trace; 5th conjure animals, haste; 7th freedom of movement, locate creature; 9th commune with nature, hold monster.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Proficiency with two martial weapons of your choice and one of Animal Handling, Nature, or Survival.

features.name: Mark Prey
features.desc: As a bonus action, mark a creature you can see within 90 feet for 1 hour: +1d6 damage on your weapon hits against it and advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks to find it. Marking a new creature ends the old mark.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Honed Instincts
features.desc: No action: learn either the saving throw and skill proficiencies or the damage resistances, immunities, vulnerabilities, and condition immunities of a creature you can see within 120 feet. Your next weapon hit against it within 1 minute deals maximum damage.

features.name: Pack Hunter
features.desc: Reaction, uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per short or long rest. Kill: when another creature hits your marked prey, it deals the Mark Prey extra damage. Retreat: when your marked prey attacks a creature you can see within 60 feet, that creature can use its reaction to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks before the attack.

features.name: Unflinching Mark
features.desc: Mark Prey damage rises to 2d6, and to 3d6 at 14th level.

features.name: Rite of the Hunt
features.desc: As a bonus action, your marked prey within 120 feet makes a Wisdom save or suffers Chase or Avoid (your choice) for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns; a success makes it immune for 24 hours. Chase: disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you, and a Wisdom save the first time it tries to move more than 30 feet from you on a turn or it can't. Avoid: disadvantage on attacks against you, and a Wisdom save the first time it tries to move within 30 feet of you on a turn or it can't move closer. Suppressed while you can't see it.

name: Trapper
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

features.name: Trapper's Tools
features.desc: Proficiency with thieves' tools and double proficiency bonus when using them to disarm or manipulate traps.

features.name: Trapped Weapons
features.desc: After a short or long rest, augment one weapon or up to 20 pieces of ammunition with acid, cold, fire, or lightning until your next rest. Once per turn on a hit with it, deal 1d8 extra damage of that type. At 11th level, augment a second weapon or 20 more ammunition, and the damage becomes 2d8.

features.name: Set Trap
features.desc: You learn traps at 3rd, 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level (see Ranger Traps). Physical traps take 1 hour and trap-making materials; magical traps are made after a long rest, up to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), some costing spell slots, and expire at your next long rest. As an action, throw a trap to a space within 30 feet; it arms at the start of your next turn and is visible unless you spend 1 minute concealing it (Wisdom (Perception) against your ranger save DC to find). Magical traps trigger on a creature of a chosen size within up to 30 feet, or with your bonus action or reaction within 150 feet. Creatures can disarm with Dexterity (thieves' tools) or spellcasting ability (Arcana) against your DC; failing triggers it with disadvantage on the save. Trap spell effects need no concentration, and magical traps must be 40 feet apart.

features.name: Ranger Traps
features.desc: 3rd: Bear Trap (physical, 4 gp: Dexterity save or 2d8 piercing and speed 0), Tanglevine (1st-level slot: entangle in 20 feet), Snare Trap (physical, 2 gp: Strength save or prone and speed 0), Solestriker (1st-level slot: spike growth in 20 feet). 5th: Immolation (2nd: 6d6 fire, Dexterity half, 20 feet), Miasma (2nd: gas cloud 20 feet for 1 minute, Constitution save or 3d6 poison and poisoned), Soulbind (2nd: Charisma save or soulbound as preserve and can't be invisible), Pit Trap (physical, 2 gp: 7-foot pit, Dexterity save or fall in, 4d8 piercing if spiked). 9th: Bewilderment (3rd: Wisdom save or 3d10 psychic and confusion), Net Trap (physical, 10 gp: 20-foot square, Dexterity save or restrained and hoisted 20 feet), Thunder Charge (3rd: 30 feet, Constitution save or 8d6 thunder and deafened). 13th: Catapult Trap (physical, 15 gp: Dexterity save or flung 60 feet, 6d10 bludgeoning), Infection (4th: Constitution save or a contagion disease), Snapfrost (4th: 20 feet for 1 minute, Constitution save or 6d6 cold, half speed, no reactions). 17th: Banisher (5th: 10 feet, Charisma save or sent to a harmless demiplane for 1 minute), Gravity Well (5th: 30 feet of difficult terrain, Dexterity save or prone, concentration checks, 2d8 force pulls each turn, then a Strength save for 6d8 force, prone, and pulled to the center, or half).

features.name: Tracker
features.desc: Add your proficiency bonus to checks to find or follow tracks even if not proficient; double it if you are.

features.name: Trapper's Avoidance
features.desc: Against a trap's activation effect that allows a save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure, and traps' attack rolls against you have disadvantage. Doesn't apply to ongoing effects.

features.name: Leave No Trace
features.desc: When you deploy a trap, expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher to make it invisible as it leaves your hand; creatures don't see where it lands and have disadvantage on saves against physical traps. You learn invisibility (a ranger spell for you, not counted against spells known) and can cast it once per short or long rest without a slot.

features.name: Booby Trap
features.desc: After a long rest, choose one effect until your next long rest; its 0 hit point trigger works once per long rest. Defibrillate: once per turn when hit by a melee attack, the attacker can't take reactions until its next turn and you move 10 feet without provoking; at 0 hit points, drop to 1 and take an extra turn, then fall to 0 if not healed. Dissolve: once per turn a melee attacker within 5 feet takes 1d6 acid (natural weapons or spell attacks) or its nonmagical ferrous weapon is destroyed if the attack hit; at 0 hit points, creatures within 10 feet make a Dexterity save or take 10d4 acid and 5d4 each turn until they wipe it off. Entomb: once per turn a melee attacker within 5 feet takes 1d4 cold and loses 15 feet of speed; at 0 hit points you are encased in ice (AC 15, 100 hp) giving total cover and no death saves for 1 minute. Self-Destruct: once per turn a melee attacker within 5 feet takes 1d8 fire and you take 1; at 0 hit points you fail one death save and creatures within 20 feet make a Dexterity save, 14d6 fire or half.

name: Skinshifter
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

features.name: Skinshifter Magic
features.desc: Spells known at sorcerer levels (not counted against spells known): 1st chameleon skin, inflict wounds; 3rd barkskin, protection from poison; 5th vampiric touch, zippit!; 7th freedom of movement, frogskin; 9th feverskin, greater restoration. On gaining a level you can swap one for a biomancy or transmutation spell of the same level from the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard list.

features.name: Skinshift
features.desc: After casting a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, roll a d20; if it is at or under a third of your sorcerer level (minimum 1), roll on the Skinshift Adaptations table for an effect until the end of your next turn (spend 1 sorcery point to extend it to 10 minutes). Results range from drawbacks (1 to 7: vulnerabilities, a left foot, the wobbles, sunlight sensitivity, disadvantage on attacks) through utility (8 to 16: shrink, light, alter self, natural weapon, jumping, swimming, tentacle reach, growth, flight) to strong boons (17 to 30: elemental and physical resistances, temporary hit points, extra attack, empowered strikes, shimmerskin, secreted toxin, +2 AC, relentless metabolism, salamander skin, fortified metabolism, reflective carapace). Skin and metabolism adaptations don't stack within their group. From 6th level, add up to half your sorcerer level to the table roll.

features.name: Selective Shift
features.desc: As a bonus action, spend sorcery points to transform for 10 minutes, choosing one adaptation per point from entries numbered up to 20 + half your sorcerer level.

features.name: Reactive Mutations
features.desc: Immediately after taking damage, use your reaction and 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to that damage type for 10 minutes or until you use this again.

features.name: Shapeshift
features.desc: As a bonus action once per long rest, transform for 10 minutes: grapples and restraints on you end, you gain six adaptations of your choice ignoring stacking limits, and immediately after taking damage you gain resistance to that type (up to three at once, oldest replaced). Reactive Mutations and Selective Shift are unavailable and end.

name: The Parasite (Heliana's)
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.desc: Added to your warlock list: 1st heroism, sanctuary; 2nd enhance ability, enlarge/reduce; 3rd haste, spirit guardians; 4th black tentacles, freedom of movement; 5th contagion, dominate person.

features.name: Parasitic Weapon
features.desc: As a bonus action, manifest a parasitic weapon. When you take the Attack action you can make a melee spell attack with it, reach 5 times your proficiency bonus in feet, dealing 1d12 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing (chosen on manifesting) with no ability modifier. Attacks rise to two at 5th level, three at 11th, and four at 17th (Extra Attack attacks replace these), and count as magical from 6th level. It can't make opportunity attacks and retracts if you are incapacitated or dismiss it as a bonus action.

features.name: Symbiotic Reinforcement
features.desc: Use your Charisma modifier for Strength saves. As a bonus action, manifest a shield in your free hand that you are proficient with (+3 AC instead of +2 from 10th level) until dismissed or you are incapacitated.

features.name: Liquefied Body
features.desc: As a bonus action once per short or long rest, become liquid for 10 minutes: squeeze through 6-inch gaps and ignore extra movement cost from difficult terrain. Equipment falls or merges, your choice.

features.name: Birth Parasite
features.desc: Over 1 minute once per short or long rest, extrude a parasitic ooze that acts as your familiar (as find familiar; counts for Pact of the Chain). Tiny ooze: AC 8 + PB, hit points 5 + three times your warlock level, speed and climb 5 + 5 x PB feet, blindsight 60 feet, resistance to necrotic, Amorphous, False Appearance, Spider Climb; Pseudopod uses your spell attack modifier for 1d6 + PB bludgeoning. A new one dissolves the old.

features.name: Transmit Parasite
features.desc: As a bonus action, command your ooze. Detonate Ooze: it moves and explodes; creatures within 10 feet make a Dexterity save, 4d6 necrotic and blinded until the end of your next turn, or half. Symbiote's Ward: it attaches to a willing creature, letting you speak telepathically and taking damage in its place until you detach it as a bonus action.

features.name: Virulent Form
features.desc: As an action once per short or long rest, for 1 minute: grow one size, gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier at the start of each turn, parasitic weapon damage becomes 2d8 and crits on 19 or 20, and when a creature within its reach damages you, you can attack it with your reaction. Optional invocation Parasitic Leech (Parasite patron): crits or kills with the parasitic weapon grant temporary hit points equal to the damage dice rolled.

name: Path of the Belly Brewer
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

features.name: Belly Concoction
features.desc: When you rage, pick a concoction (change each rage). Combat: rubbery body; reaction to reduce a ranged hit's damage by 1d12 + Constitution modifier + barbarian level, and a bonus action before a melee attack to stretch your reach 5 feet for the turn (first hit +1d6 weapon damage). Utility: as a bonus action, swallow an object that fits in your mouth (destroying it if nonmagical) and optionally spend a Hit Die to heal (die + Constitution modifier), proficiency bonus times per long rest. Whimsy: at the start of each turn, either teleport 10 feet, take 1d4 necrotic to add that number to your next check this turn, or Help as a bonus action; plus a harmless visual quirk.

features.name: Side Effects
features.desc: You learn Prestidigitation and Thaumaturgy.

features.name: Quick Brew
features.desc: Choose a common potion; once per long rest activate its effects as a bonus action (save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier). Swap it on gaining a level.

features.name: Lingering Effects
features.desc: After a long rest choose blinded, charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, or stunned; you have advantage on saves against it until you choose another.

features.name: Mighty Quick Brew
features.desc: Quick Brew gains another common potion and one uncommon potion (each once per long rest).

name: College of Masks (Obojima)
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

features.name: Tools of Performance
features.desc: Craft two theater masks (one more at 7th, 11th, and 15th level; swap one each time). Don or swap a mask as an action or bonus action and gain its abilities (save DCs use your spell save DC). Fish: swim speed, water breathing, Water Bullet and Whelm Weapon. Fox: move through hostile spaces, +1 AC, reaction for advantage on a Dexterity save. Old Man: Detect Magic and Identify at will. Protagonist: temporary hit points on initiative, mark an antagonist (advantage on checks involving it; reaction and Bardic Inspiration to reduce its attack roll). Sea Urchin: Bardic Inspiration bonus action heal, and a restraining toxin (Constitution save) proficiency bonus times per long rest. Stone: Athletics proficiency, -2 nonmagical weapon damage, advantage against being moved or knocked prone. 7th level: Demon (sense a creature's or object's past presence, see through walls 15 feet), Golem (+1d8 weapon damage, double damage to objects), Spirit (Speak with Dead, step through the Spirit Realm with Bardic Inspiration). 11th level: Harpy (fly 30 feet, psychic resistance).

features.name: Copycat
features.desc: As an action, spend a Bardic Inspiration to cast Alter Self (Change Appearance) as a humanoid you've seen, without concentration, gaining 5 temporary hit points (it ends if they're lost) and nonmagical copies of that person's visible gear.

features.name: Many-Masked Performance
features.desc: Once per long rest, a 1-minute performance targets up to your bard level creatures within 60 feet that hear you: Wisdom save or charmed, frightened, or unconscious (your choice).

features.name: Gift of Theatre
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, as an action lend one of your masks to an ally within 5 feet for 1 minute.

name: Circle of the Petal
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

features.name: Petal Dance
features.desc: As a bonus action, spend a Wild Shape use to wrap yourself in a petal cloud for 1 hour: +1 AC; a bonus action ranged spell attack within 30 feet for 1d6 slashing (2d6 at 5th, 3d6 at 11th, 4d6 at 17th); and a reaction to reduce damage to you or a creature within 10 feet by your druid level + Wisdom modifier, which disperses the cloud.

features.name: Petal Beast Mimicry
features.desc: As an action, summon a petal bestial spirit within 30 feet (CR 1 stat block: hit points three times your druid level, your spell attack modifier, fly 20 feet with hover, moves through creatures). It acts on your turn, only Dashing or Attacking (Chomp 2d6 + 2 piercing and DC 14 Strength save or prone). At 0 it bursts, giving Faerie Fire in 20 feet until the end of your next turn; otherwise it lasts 1 minute. Two uses per long rest (three at 11th, four at 16th); from 11th you can spend two uses to summon two.

features.name: Spirit of Obojima
features.desc: Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to find a path or creature. Once per long rest as an action, raise an impassable petal wall 1 foot thick, 15 feet tall, and up to 60 feet long that only creatures you designate can cross, immune to damage, lasting minutes equal to your druid level.

features.name: Winds of Revival
features.desc: Once per long rest when reduced to 0 hit points, you instead regain half your hit points, and can use your reaction so creatures within 10 feet make a Strength save or are pushed 15 feet and take 2d8 slashing.

name: The Spirit-Fused
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

features.name: Arcane Quirk
features.desc: Choose harmless quirks from your fused spirit, such as First Age gadgets glitching, coughing bubbles, or floating when unconscious.

features.name: Channel Essence
features.desc: You have four essence dice (d6), regained on a short or long rest: add one to a weapon attack roll or its damage, before or after rolling. 5 dice at 7th level, 6 at 10th, 7 at 15th, 8 at 18th.

features.name: Object Channeling
features.desc: Learn one channeling option and use it once per short or long rest; proficiency in the Salvage skill. Options: Ballooning Bag (float 30 feet up, or Feather Fall as a reaction), Entangling Cord (replace an attack with a ranged Constitution-based pull of 15 feet), Find the Thing (Locate Object without concentration, 1 hour, 1 mile), First Age Steed (summon a bonded 60-foot vehicle for 1 hour), Goggled Vision (darkvision 60 feet and advantage to spot illusions for 1 hour), Leaping Sneakers (Jump for 1 hour), Pocket Voice (speak through an object for 1 hour), Water Jettison (bonus action spray: move 10 feet back and Disengage).

features.name: Spirit Battery
features.desc: You learn Jolt (Constitution-based; powers a machine for 1 hour). Once per turn, replace a weapon hit's damage dice with Jolt's lightning dice. You count as a spirit.

features.name: Improved Object Channeling
features.desc: Learn a second channeling option; use Object Channeling proficiency bonus times per short or long rest.

features.name: Improvised Armor
features.desc: When hit by an attack, use your reaction to roll an essence die and add it to your AC against that attack.

features.name: Backup Battery
features.desc: One more use of Second Wind, and when your hit points drop below your fighter level you can spend a Second Wind immediately (no action).

features.name: Junk Master
features.desc: Learn another channeling option, and when you roll initiative with no Object Channeling uses left, regain two.

name: Sheep Dragon Shepherd
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

features.name: Herding Sheep
features.desc: As a bonus action, spend ki to move a willing creature you can see within 60 feet without provoking opportunity attacks: 15 feet per ki point toward you or 10 feet per point in another direction, up to its speed. Two creatures at 5th level, three at 10th, four at 15th.

features.name: Wind Shot
features.desc: Replace an unarmed strike with a 60-foot ranged blast of air using your unarmed strike's bonus and damage; on a hit, spend 1 ki to force a Strength save or knock it prone or push it 10 feet.

features.name: Intercepting Maneuver
features.desc: When an ally within 10 feet is hit, use your reaction and 1 ki to reduce the damage by a Martial Arts die + Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Take to the Skies
features.desc: Step of the Wind also gives a flying speed equal to your walking speed until the end of your turn, and grants both Disengage and Dash.

features.name: Guide to the Herd
features.desc: When you use Patient Defense, spend 1 more ki so allies within 30 feet that can see or hear you can use their reactions to gain the Dodge action's benefits until the start of your next turn.

name: Oath of the River
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

features.name: Tenets of the River
features.desc: The River Flows On; The River Quenches or Drowns; The River Rages; The River Seeks the Sea, Always.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.desc: Oath spells at paladin levels: 3rd Bless, Whelm Weapon; 5th Find Steed, Lesser Restoration; 9th Water Breathing, Water Walk; 13th Control Water, Freedom of Movement; 17th Mass Cure Wounds, Submerge.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: Rushing Rapids: as an action, Large or smaller creatures of your choice within 20 feet make a Strength save or are pushed 5 feet outside the area. Blessed Pool: as a bonus action, up to twice your Charisma modifier (minimum 2) creatures within 30 feet regain 2d6 hit points.

features.name: Aura of the River
features.desc: The area within 10 feet of you (30 feet at 18th level) is difficult terrain for creatures you don't exempt. The first time each turn you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee attack, you can move it up to 10 feet.

features.name: Shielding Spirit
features.desc: When you make a Dexterity save, use your reaction to halve the damage; expend a spell slot to extend this to a number of creatures within 10 feet equal to the slot level.

features.name: Form of the River
features.desc: As a bonus action for 1 minute: swim speed 60 feet and +15 feet walking speed, advantage on all saves, and creatures you move with your aura can take 2d8 bludgeoning. Once per long rest, or again with a 5th-level slot.

name: Corrupted Ranger
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

features.name: 1st Manifestation
features.desc: Taking damage grants a curse marker (two on a critical hit), lasting until the end of your next turn, up to a maximum of 2 (3 at 5th level, 4 at 11th, 5 at 17th). Your next weapon hit consumes them for 1d4 necrotic each. As a bonus action you can fill to your maximum.

features.name: 2nd Manifestation
features.desc: Replace the result of a Strength or Dexterity check with 10 + your ranger level, deciding after the roll but before the outcome. Half your proficiency bonus (round up) uses per long rest.

features.name: 3rd Manifestation
features.desc: Once per turn, spend a curse marker to add 1d4 to a weapon attack roll. Once per short or long rest, use your reaction to reduce damage you take by your ranger level.

features.name: 4th Manifestation
features.desc: Choose an ailment. Graying Vision: blindsight 15 feet and automatically see through illusions whose Investigation DC is at most your spell save DC. Failing Lungs: as an action steal a creature's breath (it falls prone, no reactions, and takes your curse markers as 1d4 necrotic each), or as a reaction give a creature advantage on a Dexterity save and +15 feet speed. Losing Feeling: as a bonus action wreathe a creature within 60 feet in cold flame so your curse markers deal 1d6 to it instead of 1d4. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: 5th Manifestation
features.desc: As a bonus action until the start of your next turn: double walking speed, +2 AC, two extra attacks with the Attack action, and attacks treated as having maximum curse markers. Free once per long rest; a second use also gives a level of exhaustion and drops you to 1 hit point.

name: Waxwork Rogue
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

features.name: Conjure Flame
features.desc: You learn Dancing Lights (as floating candles) and Produce Flame.

features.name: Wax Enchantments
features.desc: You have 3 wick points (+1 per rogue level), regained on a short or long rest, and learn three enchantments (two more at 5th, 10th, and 15th; swap one each time). Save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence or Charisma modifier. Options include Blooming Light (anti-divination light, 1), Bocha Glue Wax (bind two objects, 1), Candle Pop (bonus action Dexterity save or restrained in wax, 2), Delicacy (healing candle 1d6, 1), Fish Fat Candle (20-foot smoke cloud, 1), Flooding Abundance (15-foot square of flammable difficult-terrain wax, 2), Iron Seal (magically lock a lid or door, 1), Lost Wax Carving (Duplicate an object, 2), Maker's Mark (signet-ring strike 1d4 + Dex plus 1d6 fire with the Attack action, 1), Shielding Seal (5 to 15 temporary hit points, 1+), Spark Shower (advantage on your next attack and no opportunity attacks from the target, 2), Waxlings (candle familiars, 2), Wick Whip (finesse reach whip dealing 3d4 fire for 1 minute, 3); 5th level: Burning Delay and Detonate (20-foot burst 2d6 fire plus 2d8 thunder, 3+); 10th level: Consuming Flame (reaction Counterspell that can store a level 3 or lower spell, 3).

features.name: Burn Cycle
features.desc: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, spend wick points for 1d6 extra fire each, up to 4d6.

features.name: Advanced Enchantments
features.desc: Enchantments improve: Blooming Light lasts 8 hours, Burning Delay has more intervals, Candle Pop also affects creatures within 5 feet of the target, Delicacy heals 1d12 with up to four candles, Maker's Mark is unlimited per turn, three Shielding Seals at once, and two Waxlings for 3 points.

features.name: Spirit Flame
features.desc: Once per long rest as a bonus action, light a pink candle for 1 minute: enchantments cost 1 fewer wick point, immunity to fire damage, and spirits have disadvantage on attacks against you (falling prone risks a DC 15 Dexterity save to keep it lit).

name: Oni Bloodline
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

features.name: Arcane Prison
features.desc: Oni traits manifest by how many sorcery points you are missing (lost again as you regain them), each lasting until a long rest: 0 to 1 Eyes, 2 to 4 Horns, 5 to 9 Skin, 10 to 14 Tongue, 15+ Hair. Eyes: as an action, advantage on Charisma checks against one non-hostile creature for 1 minute (it may realize afterward on a Wisdom save and turn hostile). Horns: channel attack cantrips through a horn melee spell attack for +1d6 piercing, and use your reaction to cast such a cantrip instead of an opportunity attack. Skin: casting a 1st-level or higher spell heals you by its level + Constitution modifier. Tongue: when a verbal spell targets one creature, a bonus action forces a Wisdom save or it uses its reaction to flee half its speed or falls prone. Hair: +2 AC.

features.name: Ogre Manipulation
features.desc: Once per long rest as a bonus action, manifest one oni trait early for 1 minute.

features.name: Boiling Power
features.desc: Eyes: cast a single-target Zone of Truth without a slot while it can see your eyes. Horns: +1d12 instead. Skin: heal twice the spell's level + Constitution modifier. Tongue: with a 5th-level or higher slot, the target's passive Perception becomes 5 and it takes -5 AC against others' attacks until your next turn.

features.name: Transformation
features.desc: As an action, manifest all oni traits for 1 minute, with resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing and immunity to charm and fear. Once per long rest, or again for 5 sorcery points.

name: The Lantern
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.desc: Added to your warlock list: 1st Faerie Fire, Identify; 2nd Locate Object, Swallow Magic; 3rd Daylight, Nondetection; 4th Guardian of Faith, Locate Creature; 5th Create Spirit Train Stop, Tamh Gon's Fiery Festival Feast.

features.name: Illuminating Aura
features.desc: Your patron dwells in a lantern you can use as a spellcasting focus. Once per short or long rest as a bonus action, light it for 1 minute (bright 20 feet, dim 20 more): use your reaction to add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to a save made in its bright light, and hostile creatures in its dim light that fail a save take radiant damage equal to half your warlock level (round up).

features.name: Revealing Light
features.desc: Once per short or long rest as an action, a maroon light (bright 10 feet, dim 10 more) makes invisible creatures and objects in its bright light visible for 1 hour.

features.name: Dangerous Tool
features.desc: Illuminating Aura persists if you let go. Once per long rest (or by expending a warlock slot) control the lantern for 1 minute as a Spiritual Weapon of 2nd level (4th at 10th, 6th at 15th) while it remains your focus.

features.name: Oracle Illumination
features.desc: As an action, use a light source you can see or know as a Clairvoyance sensor for 10 minutes (once per light source per long rest).

features.name: Brilliant Illumination
features.desc: Once per short or long rest while Illuminating Aura is active, as an action, creatures in its bright or dim light make a Constitution save: 2d8 + warlock level radiant and blinded until the end of your next turn, or half.

features.name: Brighter Still
features.desc: Activate Illuminating Aura at will. Once per long rest, the lantern casts Find the Path to a place you know.

name: Origami Mage
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

features.name: An Arcane Art
features.desc: As a bonus action, proficiency bonus times per long rest, fold an origami construct bound to you or a creature within 60 feet for hours equal to half your wizard level (AC your spell save DC, destroyed by any damage). Bird: Perception proficiency and +2 slashing on ranged hits. Cat: Stealth proficiency, and once per turn after your melee weapon hit it attacks for 1d6 slashing (1d8 at 5th, 1d10 at 11th, 1d12 at 17th). Crab: +1 AC and Athletics proficiency (one at a time). Dragon: disadvantage on Stealth, no invisibility, 1d4 fire each turn to the bearer, and it explodes for 2d6 fire within 5 feet when destroyed (stackable). Frog: Acrobatics proficiency, and a reaction to add the crafter's spellcasting modifier to a failed Dexterity save, destroying it.

features.name: Origami Familiar
features.desc: Find Familiar is always prepared; your familiar is a paper Construct immune to poison and psychic. It can flatten into paper (Investigation against your DC to spot), unfurl over a creature's face (Dexterity save or blinded for 1 minute, Strength check to remove; destroys the familiar), or spend 1 minute recording sounds within 15 feet into a written transcript.

features.name: Binding Release
features.desc: As a bonus action, move one of your constructs to a creature within 30 feet of it.

features.name: Paper Path
features.desc: Your origami constructs within 100 feet can deliver your touch spells, using your attack modifier.

features.name: Origami Servant
features.desc: Unseen Servant is always prepared and castable without a slot, up to half your wizard level servants at once, lasting hours equal to your proficiency bonus; they are visible paper, fit through 1-inch gaps, fall safely, see invisible things, take individual commands in one bonus action, and you can see and hear through one as an action.

features.name: Arcane Refresh
features.desc: When a construct is destroyed, regain 10 hit points or a spell slot of 2nd level or lower. Once per long rest, use your reaction to negate damage to a construct.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Choose three, each once: a gaming set, a martial weapon, Herbalism Kits, Thieves' Tools, a skill, or two languages.

features.name: Wanderer's Lore
features.desc: A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die can make one Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion check with advantage, optionally adding the die.

features.name: Traveler's Tricks
features.desc: Learn two tricks (three at 6th, four at 14th); each costs a Bardic Inspiration and a bonus action unless noted, with save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier. Acrobatics Lessons (add the die to a Dexterity save). Armed Combat Lessons (add the die to an attack or damage roll and gain a chosen Fighting Style for 10 minutes). Bind the Wound (reaction: add the die + Wisdom modifier to healing within 5 feet). Boxing Lessons (two Dex-based unarmed strikes using your inspiration die). Conjure Woodland Spirit (action: a spectral cat guardian that deals your die in slashing to enemies moving next to it, Wisdom save). Dark Bargain (gain an Eldritch Invocation for 10 minutes for necrotic damage equal to the roll). Evocation Lessons (change a chosen spell's damage type and add the die + Wisdom modifier). Hunting Lessons (concentration: weapon attacks against a quarry add the die). Reckless Tactics (advantage and die + Wisdom damage on a heavy, two-handed, or versatile attack; attacks against you have advantage). Warding Trick (action: an ally gains temporary hit points equal to the die + Wisdom modifier while you concentrate). Each improves at 6th and 14th level.

features.name: Favorite Trick
features.desc: Designate a known trick; if you roll initiative with no Bardic Inspiration, regain one use usable only for it. A second favorite at 14th level.

features.name: Improved Tricks
features.desc: Your Traveler's Tricks gain their 6th-level improvements (and their 14th-level improvements at 14th).

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st bless, goodberry; 3rd aid, heroism; 5th beacon of hope, spirit guardians; 7th banishment, faithful hound; 9th mass cure wounds, telepathic bond.

features.name: Blessing of the Hearth
features.desc: Proficiency with cook's utensils. When you rest you conjure a hearth; you and friendly creatures resting with you can reroll one Hit Die each when healing at the end of a short rest, taking the higher.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Magnificent Feast
features.desc: Spend 10 minutes to make food items equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) lasting 8 hours; eating one (an action) heals 2d4 + your cleric level and ends frightened or poisoned.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Community Watch
features.desc: You and up to your Wisdom modifier allies within 30 feet that can see you gain a boon for rounds equal to your Wisdom modifier: once per round add a d6 to a skill check, save, or attack roll while able to see an ally.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.desc: Once per turn your weapon hits deal +1d8 psychic (2d8 at 14th), and you choose whether a foe it drops is stable or dies.

features.name: Paragon of the People
features.desc: Community Watch grants an extra d6 and immunity to fear, and Magnificent Feast makes twice as much food that also removes a curse or disease.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st sleep, veil of dusk; 3rd darkness, moonbeam; 5th nondetection, globe of twilight; 7th divination, stellar bodies; 9th dream, seeming.

features.name: Eye of Twilight
features.desc: See in dim light within 60 feet as bright and in magical or nonmagical darkness as dim (120 feet at 6th). At 8th you see normally in darkness within 120 feet, and at 17th once per long rest you gain truesight 120 feet in darkness for Wisdom modifier minutes.

features.name: Ward of Shadows
features.desc: When a creature you can see within 30 feet attacks you, use your reaction to impose disadvantage (not on attackers that can't be blinded). Wisdom modifier uses per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Invocation of Night
features.desc: As an action, extinguish all light within 30 feet; hostile creatures within 30 feet make a Constitution save or are blinded for rounds equal to your cleric level (save each turn).

features.name: Improved Ward
features.desc: Ward of Shadows can also protect other creatures attacked within 30 feet of you.

features.name: Veil of Dreams
features.desc: Sleep affects additional hit points equal to your cleric level, you choose the order of targets (skipping those too strong), and sleepers can't be woken until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Creature of the Night
features.desc: As an action for 1 minute, emit heavily obscuring darkness 30 feet and shadows 50 feet beyond that smother lesser light; enemies in the shadows are frightened, and in the darkness blinded and frightened.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.desc: Proficiency in Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth, or Thieves' Cant.

features.name: Intimidating Banter
features.desc: In combat you can use Strength or Dexterity for Charisma checks.

features.name: Brutal Brawler
features.desc: Proficiency with improvised weapons, which count as finesse for you. After an improvised weapon hit, a bonus action breaks it over the target for maximum weapon dice (+2d6 at 10th level). Advantage with improvised weapons at 18th level.

features.name: Misdirection
features.desc: As a bonus action, a creature within 5 feet that can perceive you makes an Intelligence save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Str or Dex modifier) or uses its reaction to attack a creature of your choice within 5 feet of it.

features.name: Blindside
features.desc: Once per short rest, against a creature that hasn't acted yet, one you misdirected this turn, or with advantage, a hit deals +5d6 damage (7d6 at 15th, 9d6 at 18th, when you also regain a use if you start combat without one).

features.name: Infamy
features.desc: As part of the Attack action, a creature within 30 feet that understands you makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you for 1 minute (save each turn; disadvantage if it knows your reputation).

features.name: Two For Flinching
features.desc: Once per round, when you take the Attack action against a creature you misdirected this turn or one suffering a condition, make one extra attack against it.

features.name: Thunderous Blows
features.desc: While raging, a melee hit can push the creature up to 5 feet (10 feet from 10th level); a Huge or larger creature can resist with a Strength save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier).

features.name: Spirit of the Mountain
features.desc: While raging, you can't be knocked prone or moved along the ground against your will.

features.name: Demolishing Might
features.desc: Melee weapon attacks deal +1d8 to constructs and double damage to objects and structures.

features.name: Resolute Stance
features.desc: At the start of your turn, take a stance until your next turn: you can't be grappled and attacks against you have disadvantage, but your weapon attacks have disadvantage.

features.name: Hurricane Strike
features.desc: When you push a creature at least 5 feet, use your reaction to leap next to it without provoking; it makes a Strength save or falls prone. Whenever you push a creature within 5 feet of an ally, that ally can use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it.

features.name: Unstoppable
features.desc: While raging your speed can't be reduced and you are immune to frightened, paralyzed, prone, and stunned; you can rage as a bonus action even while frightened, paralyzed, or stunned.

features.name: Poetry in Misery
features.desc: When you or an ally within 30 feet rolls a 1 on an attack, ability check, or save, use your reaction to regain one Bardic Inspiration.

features.name: Sorrowful Fate
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, when you or an ally you can see forces a save, spend a Bardic Inspiration to make it a Charisma save; on a failure the target takes psychic damage equal to a Bardic Inspiration roll and is plagued with regret for 1 minute (speaking dark final words if it drops to 0).

features.name: Tale of Hubris
features.desc: When a creature crits you or an ally within 60 feet, use your reaction and a Bardic Inspiration: for 1 minute or until it suffers a crit, weapon attacks against it crit on 18 to 20 (17 to 20 at 14th).

features.name: Impending Misfortune
features.desc: Add +10 to an attack roll or save, but your next attack roll or save takes -10 (the penalty fades on a rest). Once per short or long rest or when you drop to 0.

features.name: Nimbus of Pathos
features.desc: Once per long rest as an action, touch a willing creature for 1 minute: +4 AC, advantage on attacks and saves, +1d10 radiant on weapon and spell hits, but weapon attacks against it crit on 18 to 20, and when it ends the creature drops to 0 hit points and is dying.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st false life, sleep; 3rd hold person, ray of enfeeblement; 5th haste, slow; 7th blight, stoneskin; 9th dominate person, hold monster.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: Proficiency with martial weapons.

features.name: Bloodletting Focus
features.desc: Your instantaneous damaging spells of 1st level or higher deal extra necrotic equal to 2 + the spell's level to creatures with blood.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Crimson Bond
features.desc: Bond with a creature you can see or whose blood you hold for 1 hour (concentration). As an action, learn its distance, direction, hit points, and conditions within 10 miles, or take 2d6 necrotic to try to share its sight or hearing (Constitution save ends the bond) for Wisdom modifier minutes.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Blood Puppet
features.desc: As an action, a Large or smaller creature or corpse with blood within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save (unconscious creatures fail) or you control it for 1 minute (concentration): on its turn command it to move half its speed and interact, make one attack, or do nothing. Huge targets at 17th level.

features.name: Sanguine Recall
features.desc: Once per long rest as an action, recover spell slots totaling up to half your cleric level (none 6th or higher), taking 1d8 unreducible necrotic per slot level.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.desc: Once per turn your weapon hits deal +1d8 necrotic (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Vascular Corruption Aura
features.desc: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute hostile creatures with blood that first move within 30 feet on a turn or start there take 3d6 necrotic and regain only half hit points while inside.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st faerie fire, silent image; 3rd invisibility, moonbeam; 5th hypnotic pattern, major image; 7th greater invisibility, hallucinatory terrain; 9th dream, passwall.

features.name: Clarity of Catha
features.desc: When a creature you can see within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save, use your reaction to give it advantage. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Blessing of the Full Moon
features.desc: As an action, bless a willing creature within 30 feet: Watchful Moon (1 hour: +10 feet speed and advantage on smell-based or tracking Perception and Survival) or Blood-Drenched Moon (10 minutes: advantage on attacks against targets next to an ally).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Mind of Two Moons
features.desc: Spend a Channel Divinity to concentrate on two Moon Domain spells at once; concentration saves for both have disadvantage and a failure ends both.

features.name: Empowered Cantrips
features.desc: Your cleric cantrips deal extra damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Eclipse of Ill Omen
features.desc: Once per long rest as a bonus action, create 60 feet of reddish dim light (concentration, 1 minute): creatures you don't exempt have disadvantage on saves, and once per turn when you deal radiant damage there you can curse one, halving its speed and preventing healing.

features.name: Defile Ground
features.desc: Once per short or long rest as a bonus action, corrupt a 10-foot radius within 60 feet for 1 minute (20 feet at 10th): difficult terrain for hostile creatures, and the first time each turn a creature there takes damage from an attack or spell it takes +1d4 necrotic (1d6 at 10th, 1d8 at 14th). Move it 30 feet as a bonus action; fliers are unaffected.

features.name: Blighted Shape
features.desc: Proficiency in Intimidation. In Wild Shape you gain +2 AC and darkvision 60 feet (or +60 feet).

features.name: Call of the Shadowseeds
features.desc: When a creature that isn't undead or a construct takes damage in your defiled ground, use your reaction to summon a blighted sapling within 5 feet that can attack immediately and then obeys you on your initiative (AC 10 + PB, hit points twice your druid level, claws with your spell attack for 2d4 + PB piercing; two attacks at 14th). Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Foul Conjuration
features.desc: Beasts, fey, and plants you summon or create are immune to necrotic, poison, and poisoned, and explode when reduced to 0 (or on your action), forcing a Constitution save against necrotic damage scaled by their CR.

features.name: Incarnation of Corruption
features.desc: Resistance to necrotic and +2 AC; starting your turn in your defiled ground, a bonus action grants temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Extract Aspects
features.desc: When you hit a creature with a Flurry of Blows attack, you analyze it: you learn its damage vulnerabilities, resistances, and immunities and its condition immunities, and until you finish a rest, when it misses you, use your reaction to make an unarmed strike against it if in reach.

features.name: Extort Truth
features.desc: When you hit with an unarmed strike (or a harmless touch), spend 1 ki: on a failed Charisma save the creature can't speak a deliberate lie and Charisma checks against it have advantage for up to 10 minutes; you know whether it saved.

features.name: Mystical Erudition
features.desc: Learn a language and gain proficiency in Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, or Religion (or double your proficiency bonus in one you have). Again at 11th and 17th level.

features.name: Mind of Mercury
features.desc: Once per turn after using your reaction, spend 1 ki to take another reaction (one per trigger).

features.name: Debilitating Barrage
features.desc: When you hit with an unarmed strike, spend 3 ki to give the creature vulnerability to a damage type for 1 minute or until it takes that type (resistance is suppressed instead; immunity unaffected). Once per creature per 24 hours.

features.name: Tenets of the Open Sea
features.desc: No Greater Life than a Life Lived Free; Trust the Skies; Adapt Like the Water; Explore the Uncharted.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.desc: Oath spells at paladin levels: 3rd create or destroy water, expeditious retreat; 5th augury, misty step; 9th call lightning, freedom of the waves; 13th control water, freedom of movement; 17th commune with nature, freedom of the winds.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: Marine Layer: as an action, fog fills 20 feet around you for 10 minutes, moving with you; heavily obscured except lightly obscured for you and creatures within 5 feet. Fury of the Tides: as a bonus action for 1 minute, once per turn a weapon hit can push the target 10 feet, dealing bludgeoning equal to your Charisma modifier if it hits an obstacle or creature.

features.name: Aura of Liberation
features.desc: You and chosen creatures within 10 feet (30 feet at 18th) can't be grappled or restrained and ignore underwater movement and attack penalties; those already held can escape nonmagical restraints for 5 feet of movement.

features.name: Stormy Waters
features.desc: When a creature moves into or out of your reach, use your reaction: it takes 1d12 bludgeoning and makes a Strength save or falls prone.

features.name: Mythic Swashbuckler
features.desc: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute: advantage on Athletics and a climb speed equal to walking speed (or doubled), advantage on attacks against a lone adjacent creature, Dash or Disengage as a bonus action, and advantage on Dexterity checks and saves against effects you can see.

features.name: Essence Runes
features.desc: You have essence runes equal to your sorcerer level. At the end of a turn you spend sorcery points, that many runes become charged; a bonus action and 1 sorcery point charges two more. Five or more charged runes shed light. Expended runes go inert, and all revert after a long rest.

features.name: Runic Magic
features.desc: Spells known at sorcerer levels (not counted against spells known): 1st longstrider, protection from evil and good; 3rd lesser restoration, protection from poison; 5th glyph of warding, magic circle; 7th death ward, freedom of movement; 9th greater restoration, telekinesis. On leveling, swap one for an abjuration or transmutation spell of the same level.

features.name: Glyph of Aegis
features.desc: When you take damage, use your reaction and expend charged runes to reduce it by 1d6 per rune (d8 at 14th). From 6th level, as an action touch a creature and expend up to 3 runes to give it that protection against its next damage within an hour.

features.name: Sigilic Augmentation
features.desc: Expend a charged rune as a reaction for advantage on a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check, or once per long rest on such a saving throw.

features.name: Manifest Inscriptions
features.desc: As an action, expend a charged rune to reveal hidden or invisible traps, runes, wards, sensors, and glyphs within 60 feet for 1 minute, with advantage on Arcana to understand them and the ability to read them.

features.name: Runic Torrent
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, when you cast a spell, expend 2 charged runes to make it deal force damage; affected creatures make a Strength save or are knocked prone or pushed 15 feet.

features.name: Arcane Exemplar
features.desc: Once per long rest as a bonus action, expend a charged rune to become pure magic until the end of your turn (extend a turn at a time by expending more): fly 60 feet, disadvantage on saves against your sorcerer spells, resistance to spell damage, and heal the level of each spell you cast. Afterward you are stunned until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Blood Channeling
features.desc: While below your hit point maximum, your body is an arcane focus. You can replace a costly material component of a wizard spell by taking 1d10 unreducible necrotic per 50 gp (if it drops you to 0 the spell fails but the slot isn't spent).

features.name: Sanguine Burst
features.desc: When you roll damage for a spell of 1st level or higher, take necrotic damage equal to its level to reroll up to your Intelligence modifier damage dice.

features.name: Bond of Mutual Suffering
features.desc: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack, use your reaction to deal it the same damage (not constructs or undead). Once per short or long rest (twice from 14th).

features.name: Glyph of Hemorrhaging
features.desc: Once per short or long rest, when your spell damages a creature (not undead or construct), curse it for 1 minute: attacks that hit it deal +1d6 necrotic; Constitution save at the end of each turn ends it.

features.name: Thicker than Water
features.desc: Regain extra hit points equal to your proficiency bonus from spells and magical healing, and while concentrating you resist nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.
